job_title: Lead Technical Product Manager – Agentic AI
job_description:
Lead Technical Product Manager – Agentic AI is an impactful individual contributor who transforms strategic agentic AI initiatives and product vision into executable backlog items the team can deliver. This role bridges product strategy and tactical delivery, owning agile execution of autonomous, multi-step AI workflows that prepare tax returns and complete complex professional tasks end-to-end. Reporting to the Director of Innovation, you will partner daily with Product Managers, Engineers, and UX to decompose epics into features and INVEST-compliant user stories, ensuring development teams have clear, prioritized work that delivers customer value incrementally. This position requires deep technical understanding of agentic AI systems — including planning, tool use, and human-in-the-loop orchestration — combined with exceptional agile product ownership skills to drive rapid iteration and continuous customer feedback cycles. You will advise management on release readiness and risk and bring the voice of the customer into the team to ship outcomes that solve real problems for tax and accounting professionals.

### About InnovateHub & Agentic Tax

InnovateHub operates as Wolters Kluwer's internal innovation accelerator within TAA North America Professional Business Unit, functioning like a startup across the division. We co-design with customers, run lean experiments, and ship high-value capabilities quickly through rapid validation cycles. Our approach emphasizes customer obsession, build-measure-learn iterations, and fast value delivery to transform how tax and accounting professionals work.

### Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution (30%)

* Lead the integrated plan for work that spans multiple modules and agentic workflow components; align product, engineering, and UX to support rapid GTM
* Transform epics into clear, INVEST features and user stories with precise acceptance criteria and Definition of Ready/Done
* Ensure voice of customer and market data flows into sprint planning and backlog prioritization; translate customer feedback into actionable user stories
* Maintain a prioritized backlog in Azure DevOps Boards with 2–3 sprints of refined, ready work, visible dependencies, and unblocked paths to delivery
* Apply lightweight prioritization methods (value, risk, effort, sequencing, cost of delay) with documented rationale
* Lead backlog refinement sessions, sprint planning, and story elaboration with development teams
* Partner with Engineering on slicing, technical feasibility, release planning, feature flags, and canary rollouts
* Collaborate with Scrum Master to optimize team flow metrics, maintain predictable delivery, and remove impediments
* Apply eXtreme Programming (XP) practices where appropriate, including test-driven development support

Agentic AI Product Development (25%)

* Specify product requirements for autonomous, multi-step agent workflows, including planning behavior, tool selection, action sequencing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints
* Understand tax preparation workflows and jobs-to-be-done deeply enough to decompose them into agent tasks; identify where autonomous execution delivers value vs. where human review is required
* Define agent capabilities and constraints: which tools agents can call, what actions require user confirmation, and how state is managed across multi-step interactions
* Collaborate on retrieval and grounding requirements where agents draw on authoritative tax content (IRS publications, prior-year returns, client documents)
* Define agent-specific acceptance criteria and SLOs: task completion rate, decision accuracy at branch points, intervention rate, recovery from failure, latency budgets, and cost per workflow
* Coordinate prompts, agent instructions, model change control, and safety guardrails so demos, pilots, and production remain predictable
* Specify integration requirements for Microsoft 365 and Copilot environments, including declarative agent definitions for the Agent Store
* Work with engineering to define fallback strategies, error handling, and graceful degradation when agents encounter ambiguity

Lean Innovation & Experimentation (25%)

* Run short build-measure-learn loops with focus on validated outcomes, not output volume
* Design and execute rapid validation experiments to test hypotheses about user trust in autonomous workflows and where human oversight is essential
* Define problem-solution fit and product-market fit for agentic capabilities that maximize learning with minimal development effort
* Convert discovery signals and pilot feedback into backlog updates quickly; retire low-value items and reduce WIP
* Track innovation metrics including time-to-validation, experiment velocity, and learning rate
* Support A/B testing and feature flagging strategies for controlled rollouts of autonomous behaviors
* Apply lean startup principles to reduce waste and accelerate validated learning

Discovery & Cross-Functional Collaboration (10%)

* Coordinate with Product team for customer sessions; capture technical requirements and implementation considerations from these discussions
* Coordinate with GTM lead to ensure engineering deliverables align with launch requirements; facilitate knowledge transfer to Sales, Support, and other internal teams pre-release
* Support Product Managers in discovery by turning problem insights into hypotheses and testable stories
* Integrate user feedback, analytics, and support signals into prioritization; ensure each story anchors to real user problems
* Partner with UX on agent interaction patterns, transparency, and intervention flows that build user trust
* Work horizontally with platform, security, compliance, and content teams to meet privacy, safety, auditability, and §7216 expectations
* Produce concise artifacts that reduce ambiguity: story maps, acceptance test outlines, release notes, known limitations
* Keep stakeholders aligned with short, factual updates: current focus, what shipped, what we learned, what's next

Metrics and Reporting (10%)

* Partner with Scrum Master to maintain dashboards for delivery and product health: throughput, cycle time, story readiness, escaped defects, agent task completion rates, decision accuracy, and intervention frequency
* Tie backlog items to measurable outcomes and close the loop with post-release verification
* Track and report on key agentic AI metrics including workflow completion rates, user trust signals, model performance, and business impact

### Job Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience

Experience

* 5–7+ years in software product management or product ownership in B2B SaaS environments
* 4+ years practicing Agile/Scrum in Product Owner or Lead PM capacity, working closely with engineering
* 2+ years working with AI/ML products, with hands-on experience shipping Generative AI or agentic features in production strongly preferred
* Experience with lean product development and build-measure-learn methodologies
* Demonstrated experience in startup environments or innovation labs preferred
* Tax, accounting, or professional services software domain experience strongly preferred

Required Technical Competencies

* Expert backlog hygiene in Azure DevOps Boards: epics to features to stories, acceptance criteria, Definition of Ready/Done, dependency tracking, release planning
* Deep understanding of agentic AI concepts including LLM-based planning, tool/function calling, multi-step orchestration, state management, and human-in-the-loop design
* Working knowledge of Azure OpenAI Service, agent frameworks, prompt patterns, evaluation approaches, and safe response behavior
* Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, declarative agents, and the M365 ecosystem
* Strong grasp of INVEST principles and story mapping techniques
* Understanding of API integrations, tool/function specifications, and microservices architectures
* Knowledge of AI evaluation metrics for agentic systems (task success, intervention rate, decision accuracy), testing strategies, and MLOps practices
* Understanding of data privacy, security, responsible AI, auditability, and §7216 compliance in enterprise environments

Required Soft Skills

* Problem-first, customer-obsessed, and evidence-driven mindset
* Self-starter mentality with ability to work independently in ambiguous environments
* Critical thinking skills to challenge assumptions, simplify complex requirements, and validate hypotheses
* Exceptional written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences
* Comfort with rapid iteration and ability to pivot based on learning
* Strong facilitation and conflict resolution skills
* Clear, direct communicator who collaborates well across functions

Preferred Qualifications

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO/PSPO) or SAFe POPM certification
* Azure AI-900 or AI-102 certification
* Background in tax preparation, accounting, or professional services software
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio or declarative agent development
* Experience with agent frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
* Experience managing distributed or remote development teams
* Familiarity with document intelligence technologies

### What Success Looks Like

* A transparent, prioritized backlog with 2–3 sprints of ready stories and minimal rework
* Shipped agentic capabilities for the October 2026 1040 Prep GA that meet acceptance criteria for task completion, intervention rate, decision accuracy, safety, and usability
* Faster learning cycles, fewer blocked items, and clear evidence that shipped work solves real user problems
* Short, useful updates that keep stakeholders aligned without ceremony overhead
* Consistent delivery with decreasing cycle times and increasing customer value

  

Our Interview Practices

Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

## **About Great Question:** 

Great Question is the all-in-one AI customer research platform for understanding your customers. Our platform enables teams to recruit participants, run research, and share insights – all in one place. Backed by world-class investors and trusted by industry-leading teams like Gusto, Experian, Canva, and Brex, we’re building the future of customer research.

We believe AI is a multiplier for creativity, speed, and scale. Everyone on the team is encouraged to lean into AI, not just to be more efficient, but to push boundaries and unlock new possibilities. Whether you’re writing, designing, coding, or analyzing, we expect you to explore how AI can elevate your craft.

Our culture is built on high trust, high agency, and high emotional intelligence. If you’re looking for a place where your voice matters, where work is fun, and where you're empowered to do your best - **join us in redefining user research 🚀**

## **The role**

You are an experienced, hands on Head of Product who owns product and design end-to-end and is as comfortable in a customer call as in a pull request. You'll lead a small, senior team of two excellent PMs and a design lead, partner closely with a hands-on founding team and engineering, and bring structure to chaos and a spine to the hard calls.

We want someone who can run the function like a clock, is willing to get in the weeds on customer needs, or debate strategy with the founders or engineering teams to get to the best outcome. You are a rock-solid operator grounded in reality, competition, and the customer. Not a pure strategist who orchestrates.

## **What you'll own**

Strategy and the hard "no." Turn a dozen competing customer demands into a coherent set of bets, deciding what we don't do as clearly as what we do.

Predictable, quality delivery. Make "we ship what we commit, on time, at quality, at an increasing pace" true. It's the operating muscle a fast-moving product org runs on. Get good things into the world to learn from, without letting quality slip.

An AI-native product and team. Build AI into the product and into how the team works: more done with fewer people, and a sharp eye for signal over slop. This is how we think and build, not a layer bolted on at the end. It’s not that we can’t hire more, it’s that it’s not the first tool we reach for out of our tool chest.

A small, senior team. Coach and lead two PMs and a design lead, raise the craft bar, and grow the team behind you. Design is a strategic partner, not a service function.

The founder and engineering partnership. Own crisp decision rights with a founding team that stays close to the customer, and keep a clear line to GTM on what's coming and when.

## **You'll thrive here if you**

Bias hard to action and "prioritize finishing." You close open loops and ship at pace without dropping quality.

Are genuinely AI-native. You use AI as part of how you think, build, and operate, and you know where it creates real leverage versus where it adds noise or risk.

Think in structured bets and make decisions. You bring a framework, write things down, and are willing to be wrong and move, rather than please every stakeholder.

Are relentlessly close to customers, with a real system for where your signal comes from and how you separate signal from noise. You can defend your ground but equally believe in “strong opinions, weakly held”.

Are technical enough to be dangerous. You read the codebase, wire up your own tooling, ship a small fix, and hold a credible line on tech-debt versus velocity. You know when you can just get something done, and when you need more help; equally you know how to suggest alternative approaches to engineers in a credible way.

Communicate with unusual clarity. Your writing makes decisions obvious across time zones.

Partner with founders without deferring to them. You challenge assumptions, make the recommendation, then commit fully once the call is made.

Have led product at a growth-stage software company (research, data, or dev-tools adjacent is a bonus).

## **Our process**

We keep it real and fast:

- An initial set of calibration conversations to understand the opportunity, what you’re up against and how you fit in.
- A live working session on a real GQ strategy tradeoff. Taste and structured thinking show best in real context, so we lead with this.
- A short case study. Walk us through a product you led end-to-end.
- Conversations with the team you'd lead and partner with.

We'll move quickly for the right person.

## **Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

- A culture of customer obsession and curiosity
- Opportunity to shape and scale a critical business function
- Remote-first culture with high trust and high autonomy
- Annual team retreats and virtual events
- Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI integrations that matter
- Competitive compensation & equity
- Generous PTO, health benefits, and learning stipend

We expect every member of the Great Question community to do their part to cultivate and maintain an environment where everyone has the opportunity to feel included, and is afforded the respect and dignity they deserve.*

*Decisions related to hiring, compensating, training, evaluating performance, or terminating are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees. We examine our unconscious biases and take responsibility for always striving to create an inclusive environment that makes every employee and candidate feel welcome.*

# Our Mission and Vision

Unlearn exists to transform clinical development by making every trial smarter. We harness data, AI, and digital twins to enable faster, more robust studies that bring life-saving treatments to patients faster. This mission drives everything we do as we partner with biopharmaceutical companies to redesign how clinical trials are planned, run, and analyzed.

We are defining the future of clinical development with unmatched scientific credibility, replacing uncertainty with AI-powered precision so decisions are clearer and trials are stronger. We don’t just disrupt the pharmaceutical industry, we create lasting change.

We believe AI will define the future of medicine, and we are committed to building that future responsibly, rigorously, and in close collaboration with our partners in clinical development.

# About Our Team

We come from a variety of backgrounds ranging from machine learning to marketing—but regardless of where we come from, Unlearners share some common traits:

- **Unlearners are ambitious**; we aren’t intimidated by big, challenging goals.
- **Unlearners are disciplined experimenters**; we break down our big goals into smaller chunks and meet as often as necessary to track our velocity and iterate quickly.
- **Unlearners are gritty**; we never give up, setbacks just make us try harder.
- **Unlearners are receptive to new ideas**; in fact, we hate being stuck with the status quo
- **Unlearners are storytellers**; sharing information with each other and with the world is super important, too important to be boring. And, last but not least,
- **Unlearners are team-oriented**; we put the mission first, the company second, the team third, and individuals last.

Headquartered in San Francisco, Unlearn was founded in 2017 by a team of world-class machine learning scientists. We have raised venture capital from top tier investors such as Altimeter, Insight Partners, Radical Ventures, 8VC, DCVC, and DCVC Bio, and completed our $50 million Series C in January 2024.

**If our purpose and culture resonate with you, we invite you to apply.**

## **Your Role**

At Unlearn, we are defining the future of clinical development with unmatched scientific credibility, replacing uncertainty with AI-powered precision so decisions are clearer and trials are stronger. Our mission is to transform clinical development by making every trial smarter. We harness data, AI, and digital twins to enable faster, more robust studies that bring life-saving treatments to patients faster. We're here to not just disrupt the pharmaceutical industry, but create lasting change.

As the **VP of Product**, you will play a key role in taking our cutting-edge technology and turning it into entirely new products from the ground up—work that is truly 0-to-1. You’ll lead the development of innovative product strategies that leverage our AI platform and collaborate across Engineering, Data Science, Biostatistics, and Machine Learning. You’ll be responsible for creating entirely new products that are at the intersection of AI and healthcare, shaping the future of clinical trials and accelerating the drug development process.

You’ll work with company leadership to translate this vision into a concrete product roadmap and lead your team in delivering transformative solutions. This role requires a combination of strategic thinking and hands-on execution—transforming ambitious concepts into tangible, impactful products.

## Responsibilities

- Set and drive company-wide Product strategy, defining the long-term strategic vision and near-term execution roadmap to align with Unlearn’s vision, mission, and quarterly business goals.
- Lead the creation of entirely new products, taking novel AI capabilities from research and technical proof-of-concept to production-ready offerings that solve real problems in clinical trials and drug development.
- Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Product team — including Product Managers and, as the organization scales, other Product leaders — instilling a culture of rigorous experimentation, data-driven decision-making, and customer obsession.
- Work as a trusted partner to Engineering, Data Science, Biostatistics, Clinical Science, Business Development, and Finance leadership; and represent Product with the Executive Leadership Team and key customers.
- Bring deep familiarity with AI/ML-driven, data-intensive products to bear on decisions about what to build, how to validate it scientifically and commercially, and how to earn trust from a regulated, evidence-driven customer base.
- Develop a deep, ongoing understanding of the needs of Biopharma, Clinical, and Data Science stakeholders to ensure the roadmap drives measurable value and adoption.
- Establish operational KPIs, performance-tracking metrics, and resource allocation strategies to transition the platform from ad-hoc projects to repeatable delivery models.

## Requirements

- 10+ years in Product Management with a track record of leading Product teams and organizations, including experience operating at VP or Senior Director level with people-leadership responsibility across multiple Product Managers.
- Direct experience building AI- or data-platform-driven products in Biotech, Pharma, Life Sciences, or a comparably regulated, evidence-driven industry. You understand the clinical trial space and drug development lifecycle well enough to have informed opinions about where technology does and doesn't help.
- Product ownership from concept to reality in new markets, including defining net-new offerings rather than only iterating on existing ones.
- Strong ability to discuss clinical trial design, regulatory strategy, and competitive dynamics with senior leaders without retreating to technical jargon. You've been in rooms where the conversation was about business decisions, not Product decisions, and you contributed.
- Comfort operating across Engineering, Data Science, Biostatistics/ Clinical Science, and Commercial teams, and ability to translate between highly technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience in early-stage companies, on transformation efforts or new initiatives where the scope was unclear and the playbook didn't exist.
- Experience partnering with C-suite and communicating product strategy and trade-offs to a Board or equivalent audience.
- Strong ability to leverage data to drive Product decisions and an unrelenting focus on solving real-world customer problems through innovative Product solutions.

## Benefits & Perks

*The following benefits and perks are for full time roles only.*

- Meaningful equity participation
- 100% company-covered medical, dental, & vision insurance plans
- 401k plan with matching
- Flexible PTO plus company holidays
- Annual company-wide break December 24 through January 1
- Commuter benefits
- Paid Parental Leave

If you’re excited about this role, and your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply nevertheless.

**Job Description**  
  
The Global Merchant and Network Services (GMNS) Product team is at the heart of American Express and is a core function within the GMNS business unit. Each year, we power billions of transactions through our global payments network, serving Issuing & Acquiring partners in more than 170 markets worldwide. We grow revenue by driving strategic, multi-year initiatives to deliver differentiated value to our merchants, partners, and customers.  
  
Our solutions deliver value to American Express’ Card Members, acquirers, and partners across the globe through both proprietary and third-party capabilities, facilitating secure and seamless transactions between issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Our goal is to enable Card Members to pay however and wherever they choose. We deliver on this by setting the vision and strategy for the Network, anchoring our priorities to enterprise objectives, and developing and managing a portfolio of products. We maintain a strong customer focus, consider competitive and regulatory dynamics, and apply an end-to-end product management approach across strategy, roadmaps, scaling plans, and performance metrics. We lead the end-to-end process, manage the partner lifecycle, and drive industry intelligence and engagement through key governing bodies.  
  
The Agentic Commerce Solutions team is responsible for defining and enabling the future of Agentic Commerce across the Amex Global Network. As AI-driven agents, digital wallets, and automated commerce experiences evolve, we are shaping how the Network supports secure, scalable, and commercially compelling agent-based transactions. **[Aegis Ventures](https://www.aegisventures.com)** partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to launch and scale transformative companies in digital health and artificial intelligence. Our platform brings together market-shaping ideas, growth capital, and ambitious individuals to solve major societal problems. ### **About the Company**

[**Avandra Imaging**](https://www.avandra.io/)'s mission is to unlock clinical data to overcome previously impossible medical challenges, bringing hope and medical breakthroughs that transform patient lives. Avandra is poised to revolutionize healthcare research and innovation by creating the largest indexed data cloud of medical imaging. This platform will unlock unprecedented access to real-world imaging data, essential for biopharma research, medical device innovation, AI model training, and improved patient care.

Leveraging its strategic acquisitions, Avandra aims to aggregate and de-identify vast amounts of imaging data, providing frictionless access to this invaluable resource. With a national footprint of over 5,000 customer integrations and a market share of approximately 70%, this robust infrastructure supports their core business, ensuring continued growth and cash flow to fuel their innovative data cloud platform.

### **About the Job**

As our **Product Manager**, you will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Avandra’s image exchange platform. This role is responsible for evolving our industry-leading physical media solutions while bringing a new generation of digital image exchange products to market.

This is a unique opportunity to build products that sit at the intersection of enterprise imaging and real-world imaging data. The platform you build will not only help providers securely exchange medical images, but also create new opportunities for health systems to participate in Avandra’s imaging data network.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in enterprise imaging, understands clinical imaging workflows, and has successfully brought healthcare software products from concept through commercial launch.

### **What You’ll Do**

**Product Strategy**

* Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for Avandra’s Enterprise Imaging portfolio.
* Define and prioritize initiatives that expand our digital image exchange capabilities while continuing to strengthen our physical media solutions.
* Develop products that simplify how imaging moves between providers, patients, and healthcare organizations.
* Identify market opportunities and customer needs that differentiate Avandra in a rapidly evolving imaging ecosystem.

**Product Development**

* Lead products from concept through launch, working closely with engineering, design, sales, customer success, and executive leadership.
* Write clear product requirements and user stories that translate customer problems into actionable engineering work.
* Balance customer requests, technical constraints, and business priorities when making roadmap decisions.
* Partner with engineering throughout development to ensure successful delivery and product quality.

**Customer & Market Engagement**

* Meet regularly with health systems, imaging centers, and strategic partners to understand workflows and emerging market needs.
* Gather customer feedback through interviews, product demonstrations, and beta programs.
* Monitor competitive offerings and industry trends across enterprise imaging and healthcare interoperability.
* Represent Avandra at customer meetings and industry conferences.

**Data Network Innovation**

* Develop capabilities that make it easier for healthcare organizations to participate in Avandra’s imaging data network.
* Work cross-functionally to ensure image exchange products create long-term strategic value across both clinical and data-driven use cases.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to identify new platform capabilities that benefit providers, researchers, and life sciences organizations.

**Product Launch**

* Partner with marketing and sales to develop product positioning, messaging, pricing support, and go-to-market plans.
* Support customer enablement, product documentation, training, and launch readiness.
* Define success metrics and continuously measure product adoption and customer satisfaction.

### **What You’ll Need**

**Required**

* 5+ years of product management experience.
* Experience building enterprise healthcare software products.
* Strong understanding of enterprise imaging workflows, including PACS, VNA, DICOM, and image exchange.
* Experience leading products from concept through commercial launch. • Ability to translate complex customer workflows into intuitive software solutions. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams in Agile development environments.
* Bachelor’s degree.

**Preferred**

* Experience with healthcare interoperability technologies including DICOM, HL7, and FHIR.
* Experience in cloud-based SaaS healthcare platforms.
* Familiarity with healthcare privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
* Experience working directly with radiology departments, imaging centers, or health systems.

### **What Success Looks Like in Year One**

* Successfully launch new digital image exchange capabilities that expand Avandra’s product portfolio.
* Deliver a clear and executable product roadmap that aligns customer needs with company strategy.
* Increase adoption of Avandra’s image sharing platform across existing and new customers.
* Improve the customer experience across both physical and digital image exchange workflows.
* Deliver platform capabilities that strengthen Avandra’s position as the trusted infrastructure for imaging exchange and imaging data.

**About the role**

Schumacher is hiring a Product Manager to join the ecommerce product team. This is a newly created role: you'll join the team responsible for improving conversion all the way through add-to-cart, covering acquisition and discovery.

**Your mission**

You understand traffic generation mechanics and are an expert in ecommerce conversion. More specifically, you'll own the initiatives that drive incoming traffic to schumacher.com, as well as the features that help our designers “evaluate and compare” products, with the goal of improving add-to-cart rates. This spans products serving our internal users (such as the email campaign management tool or the CMS) as well as on-site work aimed at improving the designer experience. You'll also own cross-brand initiatives to improve the digital experience across FS&Co group brands (Schumacher international sites, Tillett, Patterson Flynn, Backdrop, and other brands in the group).

Day to day, this covers the full product lifecycle, from research to results:

**Research and discovery**

Run your own user research (interviews, usability testing, review of qualitative and quantitative data) to identify friction points and opportunities within your scope. Draw on existing product data as much as on fieldwork.

**Scoping and prioritization**

Frame problems before framing solutions. Build prioritized roadmaps based on business impact (traffic, conversion) and effort, and make the case for your trade-offs to stakeholders.

**Requirements definition**

Write clear specs and PRDs, with success criteria defined upfront. Translate business or user needs into user stories that engineering and design teams can act on.

**Delivery**

Drive day-to-day development with engineering and design teams: run agile ceremonies, make trade-off calls mid-sprint, unblock issues, and own the quality of what ships.

**Experimentation and results measurement**

Design and launch A/B tests, define success metrics, analyze results, and turn them into product decisions. Track the impact of your initiatives on traffic and conversion over time, not just at launch.

**Continuous improvement**

Treat maintenance and recurring pain points with the same rigor as major launches — a site that converts well is also a site that doesn't break.

**What we're looking for**

**Curiosity about AI —** You're quick to try new tools and processes before being asked to. AI isn't a separate topic for you: it's built into how you work day to day, as a way to move faster and produce more relevant work — in research, analysis, writing, or delivery.

**User orientation —** You start from the user need before jumping to a solution, and you're willing to push back on an idea that doesn't serve the customer experience.

**Design sensibility —** You build products that are user-friendly and usable, but also visually consistent and true to the brand. You know how to work with designers and push back on a deliverable that functions but doesn't fit the brand's identity.

**Analytical, data-driven mindset —** You're self-sufficient in going after insights yourself. You're not afraid to get hands-on with tools (analytics, SQL, dashboards) to build your own analyses rather than waiting for someone to hand them to you. Your decisions are grounded in data, not just intuition.

**Proactivity —** You spot problems and opportunities before they're flagged to you, and you take initiative without waiting for an explicit mandate.

**Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management —** You're equally comfortable driving a dev team day to day and collaborating with a range of internal teams (sales, marketing, portfolio development, data). You communicate clearly, in writing and verbally, and know how to build buy-in without forcing it.

**Global Banking and Markets**  
  
Global Banking and Markets (GBM) is a leading Canadian Capital Markets and Investment Banking business with a growing platform in the US and Latin America, operating globally for over 100 years. Scotiabank’s strong U.S. presence provides our clients an important bridge to this key global market for trade and investment flows across the Americas and the world.  
  
Global Banking & Markets provides a full range of investment banking, credit and risk management products and services relevant to the financing and strategic development needs of our clients. Our products include debt and equity financing, mergers & acquisitions, corporate banking, institutional equity sales, trading and research, fixed income products, derivatives, energy, foreign exchange and precious & metals. We also cross-sell the full range of wholesale products and services offered by the Scotiabank Group.  
  
Be part of an innovative, Global Capital Markets and Investment Banking business with a unique geographic footprint that puts capital to work for our clients across industries! We work together to drive ambition for every future!  
  
**Purpose**  
  
Own and drive regulatory and supervisory product development for Sales and Trading products across Capital Markets. Design business activities to be compliant with existing and emerging regulations. Build, create, and enhance processes that will be directly leveraged to drive business in well-controlled and sustainable manner. Create efficiencies thereby creating bandwidth and directly driving revenue generation within sales and trading desks. #GBM

**WHO WE ARE**

Arcadia is the global utility data and energy solutions platform, processing ~$35B/year in customer utility bills across 1,000+ enterprise customers. With our leading data platform, AI-powered analytics, industry expertise, and expansive partner network, we deliver solutions for every stage of the enterprise energy management lifecycle across carbon, cost, and reliability.

The processing domain of Expense Management consumes clean bill data from Arcadia’s utility data platform, Plug, and turns it into validated, actionable payables. Much of today's processing volume runs through a mature, service-intensive operation — including capabilities inherited through past acquisitions — staffed by analysts and operations teams. This role exists to modernize the current combination of legacy technology and human-in-the-loop service delivery by introducing new technology with an emphasis on AI married to optimize processes with our talents people.

Tackling an enterprise customer’s most critical energy challenges requires out-of-the-box thinking and diverse perspectives. If you share our passion for ushering in the era of clean, cost-effective electrons, we look forward to learning what you would uniquely bring to Arcadia.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We're looking for a product leader who is equally fluent in-service operations and technology product management to own Processing. You will define and execute the roadmap that normalizes and validates bill data at scale, and — critically — you will lead the transformation of a labor-intensive, legacy processing ecosystem into an AI- and automation-first operation. Understanding customer needs and market competition informs the roadmap to win in this market.

This means owning service labor optimization as a first-class product problem: understanding where manual bill entry, credential handling, and exception review consume cost and introduce error, and systematically replacing that labor with AI extraction, agentic automation, and modern tooling. The outcome is a lower cost per bill processed, healthier margins, and pricing that lets Arcadia go to market more competitively.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Processing Product & Service Roadmap**

**Bill Data Normalization & Validation:** Own the roadmap for normalizing and validating raw bill data delivered by Plug into clean, structured payables, partnering with the data platform team on upstream data-quality feedback loops.

**Service Labor Optimization:** Partner with Operations leadership overseeing tariff analysts, manual bill entry, and credential handling teams to map today's most labor-intensive workflows, quantify their cost and error rates, and prioritize which to automate first.

**AI & Agentic Automation:** Define and drive adoption of AI-powered extraction, document processing, and agentic automation across a legacy, service-heavy ecosystem — reducing dependence on manual review while holding or improving accuracy.

**Tolerancing & Exception Handling:** Own the roadmap for provider-specific tolerancing rules and exception-handling logic that shrink the volume of bills routed to manual review.

**Margin & Pricing Strategy:** Build the business case connecting automation investment to cost-per-bill-processed improvement and translate margin gains into more competitive list pricing and packaging for go-to-market.

**Legacy System Modernization:** Plan and sequence the migration of processing workflows off legacy and acquired systems onto modern, automation-first tooling — without disrupting live customer operations.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

**Payments Alignment:** Ensure Processing reliably generates clean payables that feed Payments— every downstream payment depends on the quality of Processing's output.

**Retention Protection:** Identify and close data quality gaps and processing errors before they become churn events.

**Roadmap Execution:** Maintain a prioritized, initiative-aligned roadmap with clear epics, due dates, and OKR traceability; represent Processing in cross-functional planning with Commercial, Operations, and R&D.

**WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED**

**Must-Haves**

**Service + Technology Product Management:** Proven experience owning products where the “system” includes both software and a human service operation — comfortable being accountable for a service delivery model, not just a software roadmap.

**Service Labor Optimization:** Track record of redesigning labor-intensive, service-heavy workflows (manual data entry, exception queues, offshore/BPO operations) into automated or AI-assisted processes, with measurable cost-per-unit improvement.

**AI & Agentic Product Experience:** Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered document processing, extraction, or agentic automation features into production.

**Legacy Modernization:** Experience modernizing or migrating workflows off legacy or acquired systems while maintaining operational continuity for live customers.

**Margin & Pricing Fluency:** Comfortable building business cases that connect automation and unit economics to gross margin and go-to-market pricing decisions.

**Domain Familiarity:** Experience with document/data extraction, validation logic, or high-volume back-office and transaction processing (utility billing or invoice processing a plus).

**Experience:** 6+ years of product management experience, including experience managing products with an embedded service or operations component.

**Nice-to-Have**

Experience integrating or modernizing service operations gained through M&A (e.g., legacy platforms, outsourced processing vendors).

Background in utility billing, invoice processing, or high-volume transaction environments.

  

**BENEFITS**

* "Remote first" culture - work anywhere in the US as long as you have a reliable internet connection
* Flexible PTO - no accrued hours and no limit on the number of vacation days exempt employees can take each year
* 11 annual holidays
* 10 days sick leave
* Up to 3 weeks bereavement leave
* Up to 4 weeks of caregiver leave
* Military leave for eligible services or events
* 2 volunteer days off
* 2 professional development days off
* 10 weeks paid parental bonding leave for *all* parents and additional medical recovery time for eligible employees
* 75-95% employer cost coverage for medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees and dependent

  

**Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.**

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation by emailing careers@arcadia.com prior to completing your application.

Target Annual Compensation Range for this role will be $160,000-$230,000. There will also be a competitive benefits component to the package. **What We Are Looking For:**

The Director, Insurance Product Management is responsible for the execution and delivery oversight of internal insurance systems and operational capabilities that support annuity insurance. This role partners with business, technology, operations, actuarial, compliance, data, finance, and vendor teams to help shape insurance systems strategy and vision, and to ensure roadmaps are executed effectively, priorities are managed across teams, and delivery outcomes are achieved.

This role directs execution across the full portfolio of insurance systems areas, including roadmap management, stakeholder coordination, prioritization, requirements oversight, backlog management, delivery partnership, business readiness, and continuous improvement. The role is accountable for the day-to-day management of a team of Product Managers, ensuring consistent execution, timely delivery, and resolution of cross-team dependencies across core administration, servicing, workflow, document, data exchange, and related insurance systems capabilities.

The team supports a range of internal applications, including Policy Administration, Voice, Client Ticketing, Document Generation, and Secure Transfers. This role requires strong communication skills, a high degree of ownership, and the ability to coordinate and drive alignment across internal and external teams, including partnering with business leaders to inform insurance systems strategy and direction. Experience with policy administration systems, financial services systems, insurance operations, and managing product management teams is strongly preferred. This position reports to the VP of Technology and is required to be onsite 3 days a week at our Durham, NC headquarters.

* Manage vendor relationships and coordinate contract/renewal discussions relevant to insurance systems, in partnership with Finance and Procurement.
* Ensure consistent quality, completeness, and sound judgment across the product management team in a fast-paced environment with shifting business needs and multiple concurrent priorities.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### ABOUT **THE** TEAM

  

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.

  
  

MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.

  
  

This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

  
  

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

  

As a Senior Product Manager for Applied Intelligence, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for AI-powered applications that transform how manufacturing operates. You will build and deploy ML pipelines for factory sensing, document processing, and drawing conversion, and develop RAG-enabled tools and agentic AI workflows that eliminate manual toil from business operations. You will own the deployment of these AI systems onto the factory floor and into business workflows, working shoulder to shoulder with operators, engineers, and business teams to ensure AI earns its place in their daily work.

  
  

*Product Strategy*  
You can "see around the corner" for AI in manufacturing, crafting the vision, high-level roadmap, and critical dependencies for 6 to 12 months into the future. You balance breakthrough AI capabilities with practical operational constraints, constantly engaging with stakeholders to build trust, manage expectations, and demonstrate value. You work effectively across ML engineering, data engineering, manufacturing, and business operations teams to synthesize their needs and make important decisions as the owner of your product domain.

  
  

*Product Prioritization*  
You work backward from your strategy to set clear outcomes for Applied Intelligence in partnership with your engineering, design, and operations partners. You prioritize AI use cases based on operational impact, technical feasibility, and data readiness. You support team structures that allow rapid experimentation and iteration, and you let your team flex to adapt goals when model performance, user feedback, or operational constraints require a pivot.

  
  

*Problem Discovery and Solution Generation*  
You become attached to problems, not AI solutions. You seek out real-world context through onsite observation on the factory floor, direct conversations with technicians, quality inspectors, document processors, and business operators. You identify where AI adds genuine value versus where simpler automation or process improvement wins. You capture core workflows, understand failure modes, and translate them into well-scoped AI product requirements with clear success hypotheses and model performance targets.

  
  

*Product Execution*  
From data collection to model deployment to user adoption, you fill gaps wherever needed to make your AI solutions a reality. You proactively communicate model capabilities and limitations, approach solutions with humility about what AI can and cannot do, and set a high bar for how AI products are deployed, monitored, validated, and supported in production.

  
  

### WHAT YOU'LL DO

  

* Develop a long-term strategy for AI-powered manufacturing applications, navigating complex tradeoffs between computer vision, document processing, RAG-enabled tools, and agentic AI workflows based on operational impact and technical maturity.
* Define the product roadmap for ML pipelines including factory sensing (computer vision for quality inspection, anomaly detection), document processing (drawing conversion, work instruction digitization), and intelligent automation.
* Gather and refine both functional requirements (what the AI should do) and non-functional requirements (model accuracy, inference latency, explainability, human-in-the-loop requirements) and synthesize them into a prioritized backlog.
* Communicate across stakeholders on AI roadmap and delivery, exercising judgment to educate stakeholders on AI capabilities and limitations, and managing expectations for model performance and deployment timelines.
* Walk the factory floor and observe business operations directly, talking with quality inspectors, document processors, operators, and engineers about where manual toil exists and where AI could genuinely help.
* Own the deployment and adoption of AI systems, including change management, user training, trust-building, and continuous feedback loops that improve model performance over time.
* Navigate organizational dynamics between Applied Intelligence, data engineering, software engineering, and business operations teams, advocating for the right level of AI investment and the right human-in-the-loop controls.
* Explore and incorporate frontier AI technologies including RAG pipelines for knowledge management, agentic AI for workflow automation, and computer vision for manufacturing applications.
* Define success metrics and KPIs for AI systems including model performance, user adoption, operational impact, and ROI, and track these metrics to demonstrate value.
* Drive adoption and enablement of AI-powered tools across production, quality, engineering, and business operations teams.
* Partner with ML engineers and data scientists to ensure training data quality, model validation processes, and feedback loops that continuously improve AI performance.

  
  

### REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  

* 8+ years in a software product management role or similar leading role in product development, with at least 3+ years focused on AI/ML products.
* Domain expertise within manufacturing, industrial operations, or AI/ML applications in operational environments.
* Demonstrated ability to gather and refine requirements for AI/ML systems including model performance targets, data requirements, human-in-the-loop workflows, and explainability needs.
* Strong understanding of ML product lifecycle including data collection, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

* Demonstrated success working directly with end users in operational environments, observing where AI can add value and where simpler solutions are more appropriate.
* Ability to navigate cross-team dynamics between ML engineering, data engineering, software engineering, and business operations teams.
* Ability to balance requirements across engineering, design, data science, and business stakeholders while maintaining focus on operational impact.
* Proven ability to "see around corners" by crafting AI product strategy for 6 to 12 months into the future, anticipating technology trends and operational needs.
* Comfort maturing AI products from proof-of-concept to enterprise-grade production with monitoring, validation, and continuous improvement.
* Must be able to travel up to 25% of the time.

### PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  

* Experience building or owning AI/ML products for manufacturing including computer vision for quality inspection, predictive maintenance, document processing, or intelligent automation.
* Hands-on experience in manufacturing industries with time spent on assembly lines or in production facilities understanding where AI can solve real operational problems.

# **About Mercor**

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

### **About the Role**

Trust is the foundation of Mercor's marketplace. With hundreds of thousands of experts applying for jobs and over $XX million paid out every day, the integrity of who's on the platform and how they work directly determines the quality of the data we deliver to every lab and enterprise. Defending against adversarial, fast-moving threats is one of the highest-leverage problems at the company.

You'll own the fraud detection and enforcement product and policies end to end: the multi-agent system that scores risk across expert lifecycle stages; the signals that feed it; and the enforcement actions. You'll also own the operational edge of trust and safety, designing the workflows reviewers live in, developing the governing policies, and closing the loop between what we catch in production and what we build next.

Partner with engineering, data science, operations, legal, and GTM, and move fluidly between building operational systems, analyzing model changes and whether they actually improved business outcomes, and working directly with strategic customers.

This is a technical, customer-facing role for someone who is energized by problems with no fixed playbook, who cares about both the system and the humans operating it, and who wants to own a product area where the stakes and the impact are unusually hig

### **What You’ll Do**

- **Work backwards from the business**: Connect Trust and Safety decisions to Mercor long term health, expert trust, and client trust, and use that to prioritize business outcomes
- **Own the Trust and Safety product end-to-end**: Set the roadmap for Mercor's Trust and Safety systems and own the lifecycle from signal detection to enforcement action.
- **Improve Detection quality**: Work with data science and engineering to tune models, prompts, and signals against real caseloads driving down false positive rates while holding the line on false negatives and expand automated decisioning as accuracy improves.
- **Build the Operations Tooling**: Design the products and workflows that our operations analysts use every day. Orient them around the action being taken, keep evidence bars and audit trails clear, and make high-severity calls defensible.
- **Get in the weeds**: Write specs and PRDs, but also build dashboards, pull SQL, and make small PRs to unblock yourself and validate direction.

### **What We’re Looking For**

- **Experience**: 5+ years in Product Management, Product Operations, Technical Program Management, Trust & Safety, Risk, Fraud, or a similar technical, operationally-minded role. Prior exposure to safety or integrity problems is a strong plus.
- **Technical Fluency**: Comfortable with large datasets, AI agents, unblocking and accelerating engineering. Able to reason about how detection models and signals behave, and to hold your own in technical conversations with engineers and data scientists
- **Systems Thinking**: A passion for building repeatable systems and fixing problems that span across multiple systems. Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills.
- **Ownership**: Thrive in ambiguous, adversarial environments and take ownership from problem definition through execution. High accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.
- **Judgment**: Comfortable weighing the cost of a false positive against a missed fraud case, and making the tradeoffs explicit and consistent.

**About Argus Cognitive, Inc.**

Argus Cognitive, founded in 2016, develops software as a medical device (SaMD) solutions that give clinicians and patients more in-depth information from standard clinical assessments. Our work spans multiple clinical disciplines, including behavioral health.

Our flagship product, **Neurora**, is a clinical decision support SaMD that analyzes behavioral biometrics captured during diagnostic session videos to support the diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder. Our goal is to help more children be assessed quickly, regardless of geographic location or socioeconomic status, giving families and clinicians the objective, measurable information they need for early and effective intervention. Neurora plays a role not only in autism assessment, but in expanding access to care more broadly.

**About the Position**

Neurora is awaiting FDA clearance and is preparing to launch later this year. The Product Manager will sit between engineering, clinical, and commercial teams, making sure Neurora actually supports clinical workflow requirements.

We're looking for someone who has managed a product through a full commercial launch at an established company and can bring that experience to a growing one. The right person can take what users need and explain it clearly to engineering and R&D so they can build it, and can prioritize those needs realistically against what the existing systems can support. The right person can move seamlessly between high-level strategy discussions, logistical planning, and hands-on execution.

This is not an entry-level role.

**Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap, ensuring Neurora stays on track to meet key milestones
* Manage the product backlog and sprint priorities in support of the roadmap and company goals
* Translate user needs into product specifications that align with FDA regulatory requirements, in partnership with engineering and clinical leadership
* Monitor how Neurora is used in practice, identifying where analyses fail, where clinicians disengage, and which features go unused
* Engage regularly with clinical partners, pilot sites, and early customers to maintain a clear understanding of their needs
* Proactively gather and analyze usage data to identify problems and opportunities
* Own problems and opportunities from identification through to a live, working solution
* Support launch logistics, including coordination with internal stakeholders and outside agencies on marketing materials and sales collateral
* Operate within a regulated environment, adhering to our quality system and regulatory requirements, and safeguarding cybersecurity, intellectual property, and patient privacy
* Support planning for the introduction of Argus products outside the U.S., primarily in Europe and the Middle East
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Minimum of five years of product management experience, ideally at a healthcare technology, software, or life sciences company
* Demonstrated experience taking a software product through a full development and commercial launch cycle
* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, or life sciences
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

**Preferred:**

* Experience in behavioral health, autism care, or other clinical diagnostic tools
* Experience in a regulated industry (medical device, pharma, or similar)
* Master's degree in business, economics, or life sciences
* Formal project management experience or certification

**Additional Requirements**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage both technical and clinical stakeholders
* Sufficient technical fluency to communicate effectively with software engineers
* Comfortable working directly in tools such as Jira, analytics dashboards, and documentation platforms
* Willingness to travel to clinical sites within the U.S. as needed (approximately 10-20% of time)

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to do work that makes a meaningful difference in children's lives
* Direct exposure to decision-making across the organization
* Mentorship and coaching within a collaborative team
* Full-time employment at a competitive salary, commensurate with skills and experience

report on status; recommended courses of actions, competing capabilities, performance, risks, and impacts to the

IFMC mission.

configuration, and network status monitoring. The desired candidate would also have a broad understanding of

SNMPv3. The candidate must be able to work directly with the Agile software developers to meet deadlines and

program objectives.

· Be fluent in the Microsoft Office toolset

· Be a US citizen

· Have a Bachelor’s degree (or advanced degree) from an accredited college (ABET preferred) in engineering,

the sciences or mathematics,

· Have a minimum of 10 years combined Government/DoD experience in performing the essential duties listed

above.

out" and champion your ideas, architectures, designs, enthusiasm; independent critical thinking; and a team attitude are

certification

Momentive Technologies applies advanced materials science to design and manufacture ultra-high-performance quartz materials, quartz crucibles, and ceramic products that are vital to a variety of high-growth end markets, including the silicon and compound semiconductor industries, electronics, and aerospace components. These solutions enable the production of logic and memory chips, power control devices and multiple systems for electric vehicles, integrated circuits, power control devices, data servers, and aerospace applications.

Recognized for the purity, performance, consistency and stability of its products, Momentive Technologies has been delivering innovative solutions for over 130 years and continues to impact emerging trends like electrification, digitalization, renewable energy and artificial intelligence. The Company, headquartered in Strongsville, Ohio, has operations across the globe and serves customers in more than 30 countries. For more information, visit [www.momentivetech.com](https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.momentivetech.com%2F&data=05|02|nicole.osullivan%40momentivetech.com|ec7caf73215a43b17ceb08dcd3f462f8|f91b5a71808a4232ae89fcbd3650cd6a|0|0|638618293843711304|Unknown|TWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D|0|||&sdata=Z9nO8r6laq8iTAYNJCG%2BFuwUA%2BXtEwfCYmwrcLFBOGk%3D&reserved=0).

  

**Senior Product Development Manager - Quartz Technology**

In this role you'll lead the development of revolutionary technologies, diving into the creation of advanced materials that will redefine possibilities. Your role will be leading key development projects to produce groundbreaking products, through processes and equipment developed and designed by Momentive Technologies personnel and external experts. This role will be the key R&D interface during the scale up engineering process, working with the global manufacturing team to enable high-volume manufacturing.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead a cross-functional team to develop and produce new quartz products and processes utilizing technical and project management expertise to deliver and meet market/application demands.

* Demonstrated ability to seek, collaborate, and manage key external vendors and partners.

* Lead team with responsibilities that include feasibility testing, prototyping, gauge development, pilot testing, IP identification, cost analysis and scale up to manufacturing.

* Apply project management skills in planning, budgeting, time management, resource allocation, and risk management.

* Generate intellectual properties such as patents, publications, and internal reports.

* Apply Six Sigma methodology, statistical, surface and materials characterization tools for process improvement, failure analysis and troubleshooting.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related field
* Experience leading a small team of engineers to develop and scale-up equipment and processes into production-ready status

* Proven record of leading key projects with significant investments (>$1MM) through development to high volume manufacturing.

* 12+ years of hands-on industry experience capable of contributing valuable insights immediately.

* Project management experience - effective planning and prioritization of projects of significant business impact to deliver new product/process technologies.

* Proven ability to collaborate with manufacturing, supplier, and customers to accomplish project objectives on time and within budget.

* Ability to do hands-on work in an industrial environment with necessary PPE

* Demonstrated comfort with interacting and influencing other functions in a matrixed environment.

* Experience conducting and interpreting thermal and mechanical modeling of components and equipment.

* Proficient in statistical design and analysis of experimental data including design of experiment, hypothesis testing and Gage R&R.

* Experience conducting Functional, Design and Process Failure Modes and Effect Analysis.

* Experience working with statistical software such as Minitab.

* A strong sense of accountability, urgency, and self-direction.

* Ability to travel internationally (~10%)

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics or related field.
* Understanding of basic mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic systems involved in the operation of batch and continuous furnaces.

* Experience with, or design of, quartz fusion processes including electric fusion, arc fusion and flame fusion.
* Expertise in working with and the design of high temperature processing equipment of quartz, glass, or ceramics.

* Experience designing products for semiconductor processing equipment and familiarity with the semiconductor tool market.

* Mechanical design using SolidWorks.

* Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Flow Simulation using Ansys

* Six Sigma training and/or certifications.

* Project management training and/or certifications.

  

Our **Senior Product Development Manager - Quartz Technology** will earn variable compensation including a base salary and bonus. Base salary range takes into consideration experience, education, and training. Not to mention all the amazing benefits available for employee selection as well.

Joining the Momentive team includes:

* Medical/Prescription Drug Coverage

* Dental Coverage

* Vision Coverage

* 401(k) plan with Company Match

* Basic and Voluntary Life/AD&D Insurance

* Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance

* Employee Assistance Program

* Wellness Program

* Tuition Reimbursement

* Employee Referral Program

  

Momentive Technologies is not just shaping materials; we're shaping the future. As a leader in the fused quartz, ceramics, and crucibles industry, we pride ourselves on innovation, precision, and excellence. When you join us, you'll be part of a dynamic team that's driving advancements in technology, research, and applications across various sectors.

Don't miss this chance to advance your career and make a meaningful impact on industries that impact the world.

Ready to embark on a journey of discovery? **Apply now!**

Physical Demands (Include lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, bending, walking, standing, sitting):

About the Role

We are growing and expanding our Endpoint Management Product team and are looking for a Product Manager to join a group of PMs working together on the foundational capabilities that power NinjaOne’s endpoint management platform. This role reports to the VP, Product Management and operates as part of a highly collaborative PM team focused on building and evolving the core building blocks of endpoint management.

This role covers core platform capabilities such as Automations/Scripting, Policies, Agents, Device/Organizational dashboards, and other foundational features that underpin everything customers do in NinjaOne. While these capabilities are deeply technical in nature, this is a product role focused on defining the right features, workflows, and abstractions that allow IT teams and MSPs to manage endpoints efficiently, safely, and at scale.

You will work closely with engineering, design, and cross-functional partners to shape product direction, define roadmaps, and deliver high-impact endpoint management capabilities. You’ll also collaborate closely with other Product Managers to ensure NinjaOne continues to lead the market in how modern endpoint management platforms are designed, used, and evolved.

If you enjoy building core product capabilities, working close to real-world IT use cases, and helping define what “great” looks like in endpoint management, we’d love to hear from you.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, \*IL, KS, ME, MA, MD, NJ, NC, NY, OH, OR, TN, TX, VA, & WA.

What You’ll be Doing

* Product Vision & Leadership   
  Help define and evolve the vision for NinjaOne’s core endpoint management capabilities, ensuring we continue to lead the market in functionality, usability, innovation and flexibility.
* Roadmap & Prioritization   
  Contribute to and own key parts of the core platform roadmap. Evaluate opportunities, set priorities, and make trade-offs that deliver the most value to customers and the business.
* Endpoint Management Capabilities   
  Drive product direction for core features such as automations, policies, agent behaviour, configuration models, and other foundational capabilities used across the platform.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration   
  Work closely with engineering, design, support, and other stakeholders to bring new capabilities from concept to delivery, ensuring features are well-defined, usable, and solve real customer problems.
* Customer & Market Insight   
  Engage with customers, MSPs, and internal teams to understand how endpoint management is used in practice. Translate those insights into product improvements and new capabilities.
* Product Craft & Execution   
  Write clear product requirements, define workflows and edge cases, and ensure features are delivered to a high standard. Iterate based on feedback and usage data.
* Platform & Ecosystem Thinking   
  Ensure core platform capabilities work cohesively across NinjaOne and enable other product areas to build on top of them effectively.
* Other duties as needed

About You

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

* 5+ years of experience in IT or technical roles such as managing or working in an IT helpdesk, at an MSP, or in an internal IT team.

* 2+ years of Product Management experience in an RMM/Endpoint Management role
* Background in system administration, such as:

* Windows, macOS, or Linux administration

* Endpoint management, device configuration, automation, or scripting

* Experience in MSP, internal IT, or infrastructure-focused roles

* Deep understanding of how IT teams manage endpoints in real-world environments.

* Comfortable working closely with engineers and understanding technical concepts without needing to write production code.

* Proven ability to take product features from idea to delivery and iterate based on customer feedback.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Data-informed decision maker who balances customer needs, product quality, and business priorities.

* Able to influence and align stakeholders without formal authority.

* Experience working in a collaborative, multi-PM environment is a plus.
* Must be able to work Eastern Time zone hours, with a mandatory start time of 8:00 AM ET

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries. ​

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. ​ NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

\*Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 per year.

For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 per year.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment.
