job_description:
**Description**  
  
**About Guideline**  
  
Guideline is a global provider of ad intelligence and media plan management technology, powering the strategy, planning, and management of advertising buying and selling for the world’s leading enterprises. Our solutions deliver the industry’s most comprehensive and timely insights, enabling publishers, agencies, brands, investors, and consulting firms to optimize media performance and drive superior business outcomes.  
  
Guideline’s proprietary spend and pricing data represents approximately $200 billion in annual media investment across 65 countries, providing the most complete and transparent view of the global advertising marketplace available today. In 2026 we are accelerating our investment in analytics and AI-powered solutions for the advertising and capital markets industries.  
  
**About The Role**  
  
Guideline is the leading provider of Media Plan Management solutions through Mediatools and Lumina. Today, the world's largest agencies manage billions of dollars in ad spend across fragmented systems, resulting in inconsistent taxonomies, manual reporting processes, and limited real-time visibility into media plans.  
  
Reporting directly to the SVP of Media Plan Management, this role is responsible for defining and delivering the product capabilities that solve these challenges across both platforms. You will own the end-to-end media planning experience—including plans, flights, approvals, briefs, budgets, and related workflows ensuring a consistent, scalable experience in both Mediatools and Lumina.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  

* Define how each core use case should work, and decide what has to be identical across our Media Plan Management solutions.
* Prioritize what ships, and when, for the core workflow areas: media plans, flights, approvals, briefs, and budgets, across platforms.
* Own the commercial outcome of these use cases: what's driving expansion, what's putting retention at risk, and where a new capability or pricing change would move the needle, on either platform.
* Use Guideline's AI and MCP Server infrastructure as the shared lever for both platforms: features that beat feature parity, not just match it.
* Bring client and market reality into the room with leadership. Every call here should trace back to something a client actually said or did, not a hunch.
* Work directly with agencies and brands to build the workflows and solutions they actually need, not just what's already scoped.
* Build and ship the way the rest of the team does: AI, API, and MCP-first, with agents and skills as a normal part of the workflow, not a special project.

**Required Skills & Experience**  
  

* 10–14 years in product management with real depth in media planning, buying, or agency workflow tools.
* Has owned a workflow or capability that had to work the same way across more than one product or platform, not just one owned end to end.
* Has owned a product with direct commercial accountability. Understands how product decisions translate into expansion, retention, and revenue, not just usage.
* Understands how brand and agency users pull in different directions on the same platform, and has built for both sides.
* Comfortable owning a single set of use cases that has to work across two different platforms, each with its own architecture and constraints.
* Operates at Director scope as an IC. Earns influence through quality of thinking and earned credibility, not authority.
* Builds and deploys AI agents and skills, and works comfortably with APIs and MCP as core design primitives, as part of everyday work; a baseline at this level, not a differentiator.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**  
  

* Direct experience with media planning platforms (Camphouse, Mediaocean/Prisma, MINT, or similar) as a builder, buyer, or user.
* Familiarity with agentic AI in planning workflows: quality scoring, suggestions, benchmarking, or similar AI-assisted features.
* Experience expanding usage within agency or brand accounts. Understands the motion that turns product adoption into revenue.
* Background solving this with a shared design system or component library, not just tribal knowledge passed between teams.
* Familiarity with multi-market governance or global agency/brand account structures.

**Benefits:** Guideline offers full- time employees a comprehensive benefits package based on location. Some benefits may include, but are not limited to:  
  

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account
* STD, Life, LTD and AD&D
* 401(k) with a company match program
* Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid Parental Leave
* Commuter Benefits
* Employee Recognition Program
* Referral Bonus Program

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Guideline is an equal opportunity employer, committed to our diversity and inclusiveness. We will consider all qualified applicants ithout regard to race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or age. We strongly encourage women, people of color, members of the LGBTQIA community, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply.

Product Manager Specialist, Nasdaq Eqlipse Trading Ocean  
  
Nasdaq is seeking a Product Manager to support the Ocean trading platform portfolio within Nasdaq Eqlipse. The role focuses on technology for U.S. equities trading, including alternative trading systems and single-dealer platforms. Working with senior product leaders, sales, engineering, operations, and compliance teams, the Product Manager will help manage product requirements, roadmaps, pre-sales activities, releases, and client implementations across matching, surveillance, regulatory reporting, infrastructure, and operational solutions.   
  
This role offers the opportunity to develop product-management expertise in electronic trading while working with experienced capital-markets and technology professionals. The successful candidate will contribute to mission-critical platforms, engage with leading financial institutions, and gain exposure to the complete product lifecycle.  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

The Product Manager is responsible for the development, implementation, and ongoing management of Medicare Advantage products, benefits, and member experiences across assigned markets and member segments. The Product Manager serves as a cross-functional leader partnering with Actuarial, Finance, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Network, Digital, Community Engagement, and other stakeholders to develop competitive, compliant, and member-centered products. **2. Drive Benefit Design and Product Development**

Lead the development and refinement of benefit offerings, plan features, and member experience enhancements. Partner with Actuarial, Finance, Compliance, and Operations to evaluate affordability, utilization impact, regulatory requirements, and long-term sustainability.

**3. Support CMS Bid and Regulatory Activities**

Participate in annual bid development, product implementation activities, service area expansion initiatives, and other Medicare Advantage product planning efforts. Ensure products, materials, and business processes align with CMS regulations and organizational compliance standards.

**4. Conduct Market and Competitive Analysis**

Analyze market conditions, demographic trends, consumer insights, competitive benefit offerings, and healthcare industry developments to identify growth opportunities and product differentiation strategies. Present recommendations to leadership and key stakeholders.

Oversee the development and review of member-facing communications, enrollment materials, benefit documentation, and digital experiences to ensure accuracy, compliance, accessibility, and alignment with member needs. Serve as the product lead for assigned initiatives by coordinating stakeholders, developing project plans, managing timelines, identifying risks, and driving execution across matrixed teams.

Track and analyze product performance metrics, including membership growth, retention, benefit utilization, market share, operational outcomes, and member experience indicators. Develop recommendations and present findings to leadership to support strategic decision-making.

Maintain current knowledge of Medicare Advantage regulations, CMS guidance, healthcare market trends, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities affecting product strategy and performance.

**Location: Location: Hybrid - Irvine, CA**

Mutual of Omaha is a Fortune 300 Company. Mutual of Omaha Mortgage is inspired by hometown values and a commitment to being responsible and caring for each other. We exist for the benefit of our customers and employees.   
   
Mutual of Omaha Mortgage is a full-service lending company offering both Forward and Reverse Mortgage products including a complete line of residential mortgage, refinancing, specialty, and HECM loans. We employ a knowledgeable staff of experienced Loan Officers with an operations team that is second to none. If you are interested in joining a team that promotes from within and works together toward a common goal of helping customers with their mortgage needs, please review and apply for our opening below!

Mutual of Omaha Mortgage is hiring a **Technical Product Owner — AI** to own the performance and lifecycle of our AI products. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone who can take AI products from 0-to-1: scoping the problem, shaping prompts, partnering with engineering and data, instrumenting outcomes, and driving measurable lift on conversion, containment, and customer experience metrics. You will sit on the AI Initiatives team and own a portfolio that spans voice and SMS AI agents, agent-assist tooling, and the data and observability foundation that keeps them performant.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Define, instrument, and report on KPIs for each AI product — including containment rate, goal completion, AI resolution rate, conversion, drop-off, and revenue attribution
* Run weekly performance reviews on live AI products; identify regressions, root-cause them across prompt, model, data, and integration layers, and drive fixes to closure
* Build and maintain QA sampling frameworks and call/conversation review processes; turn qualitative findings into prompt and flow changes
* Take new AI use cases from concept to production: write the PRD, define success metrics, scope the MVP, partner with engineering and vendors on build, and lead the launch
* Run structured POCs (typically 30–90 days) with clear hypotheses, evaluation rubrics, and go/no-go criteria
* Own vendor evaluations end-to-end — requirements, scoring, reference checks, contract input, and onboarding through the EVMP and AI governance processes
* Author, version, and tune prompts for voice agents, SMS agents, and assistive AI tools across the customer and loan officer journeys
* Design and run prompt evaluations: build eval sets from real conversations, score outputs against rubrics, and iterate systematically rather than anecdotally
* Translate operational requirements (compliance disclosures, escalation rules, brand voice, edge cases) into prompts, tools, and guardrails the model will actually follow
* Write production-quality SQL against Databricks, Salesforce, Encompass, and call/conversation log sources to investigate performance, build dashboards, and answer ad-hoc questions
* Partner with data engineering on the schemas, pipelines, and event tracking needed to measure AI product performance
* Read API documentation, debug integrations, and reason about call flows, webhooks, and tool-use patterns at a level where you can have a substantive conversation with engineers
* Serve as the single point of accountability for assigned AI products: align stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Engineering
* Contribute to AI governance reviews and ensure products meet NIST AI RMF expectations and applicable state AI law requirements

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years in technical product management, product ownership, or a comparable applied AI/ML product role, including direct ownership of a production AI or ML product’s performance metrics
* Demonstrated 0-to-1 experience — you have shipped at least one product from blank-page concept to live, measured users, and can speak credibly about what worked, what failed, and why
* Hands-on prompt engineering — you have written, evaluated, and iterated on production prompts for LLM-based products (chat, voice, SMS, agent-assist, or similar)
* Strong SQL — comfortable writing multi-table joins, window functions, and CTEs without help; can pull and analyze your own data on Databricks, SQL Server, or equivalent
* Data fluency — comfortable with funnels, cohort analysis, and basic statistical reasoning; able to build a dashboard or explanatory chart yourself
* Technical literacy — you can read REST API docs, trace a webhook, and discuss system design with engineers without needing translation
* Operating rigor — strong written communication, structured PRDs, clear success criteria, and a track record of holding yourself and your partners to measurable outcomes
* Salesforce experience — hands-on experience working with Salesforce as a product owner, admin, or power user; comfortable with objects, flows, reports, and SOQL
* Mortgage industry experience — direct experience with mortgage operations, loan origination, or servicing (HECM/reverse, forward, or related)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with conversational AI platforms (Bland AI, ElevenLabs, Twilio, Five9, or similar) and contact center architecture
* Startup or early-stage product experience — comfort operating in ambiguity, building from scratch, and moving fast without heavy process
* Familiarity with Databricks and the Lakehouse/Medallion data architecture pattern
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF and U.S. state AI law landscape (Colorado, Texas, California, Utah)

  
The salary range for this position is $125,000-$145,000 annually.

**Company Description**  
  
VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.  
  
**Job Description**  
  
**Senior Product Manager, AI Platform – Equity Research**  
  
VERSANT is an independent, publicly traded company that brings together powerhouse brands such as CNBC, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC), USA Network, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Golf Channel, along with dynamic digital and direct-to-consumer brands such as Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, and GolfPass.  
  
StockStory, part of CNBC and VERSANT, is building the next generation of AI-powered equity research for individual investors. We operate like a startup—a small team with high ownership, fast decisions, and direct access to leadership—while benefiting from the resources and long-term commitment of a well-capitalized public company.  
  
Our mission is simple: help millions of individual investors make better investment decisions. We’re combining AI, institutional-quality investment research, proprietary data, and exceptional engineering to redefine how retail investors discover, research, and evaluate stocks.  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with deep experience building consumer investing, financial research, or market-data products to help us build a new generation of AI-powered equity research products.  
  
This role sits at the intersection of consumer fintech, public equities, financial data, and AI. You will work with a high-caliber team that brings together top-tier engineering and buy-side investing talent, including analysts with prior experience at firms such as Millennium, Point72, and KKR.  
  
In this role, you will own and shape core product experiences across our AI equity research platform, particularly products that help investors discover stocks, conduct research, compare opportunities, understand investment theses, and build conviction. These may include AI-powered research reports, stock recommendations, screeners and discovery tools, company pages, watchlists, portfolio insights, and conversational research experiences.  
  
This is a hands-on product role for someone who wants to stay close to users, product details, data, and execution. You do not need to have worked professionally as an equity analyst, but you should be an active individual investor with strong public-markets fluency. You should understand how investors move from discovering a stock to researching the business, evaluating valuation and risk, comparing alternatives, and ultimately making an investment decision.  
  
You will identify the highest-value customer problems, define product requirements, validate assumptions with users and data, and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Equity Research to ship experiences that make institutional-quality research accessible and actionable for a large retail investor audience.  
  
The team is part of a new organization, which means you will have meaningful influence over both the products we build and the product culture we establish. **Company Description**  
  
Oterra is the global leader in naturally sourced colors for food, beverages, dietary supplements, and pet food. With over 140 years of expertise, we believe nature got it right the first time. Join our fast-growing, international team and help us make natural, healthy food accessible worldwide.  
  
**Job Description**  
  
**Role Overview**  
  
The Senior Global Product Manager reports directly to the Chief Product & Strategy Officer and holds strategic and commercial responsibility for assigned natural color pigment portfolios across food, beverage, and pet food applications.  
  
The role translates market insight, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and portfolio economics into clear product strategies, innovation priorities, pricing recommendations, and cross-functional execution.  
  
Success is defined by measurable growth, stronger portfolio differentiation, improved profitability, and long-term value creation for customers and Oterra.  
  
**Overall Objective**  
  
Own the strategic and commercial performance of assigned natural pigment portfolios, ensuring each product has a clear market role, lifecycle position, value-based pricing logic, and investment rationale. Bring discipline to portfolio choices by prioritizing the opportunities with the strongest potential to drive growth, differentiation, margin improvement, and customer value.  
  
Translate customer insight, competitive intelligence, market data, and portfolio economics into actionable decisions across product strategy, innovation, pricing, and go-to-market execution. Operate as the connective point between Commercial, Applications, R&D, Operations, Finance, and regional teams, ensuring portfolio decisions are fact-based, commercially grounded, and consistently executed.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  

* Market, customer, and competitive insight
* Act as the internal subject matter expert on assigned pigments, applications, market dynamics, customer needs, competitive developments, and relevant regulatory shifts.
* Own a structured Voice of Customer program, including customer interviews, application feedback, complaint analysis, and commercial input, ensuring insights are documented and translated into portfolio, innovation, and investment decisions.
* Develop segmentation models, value propositions, and differentiated positioning for each pigment system to strengthen customer relevance and competitive advantage.
* Participate in selected customer engagements as product and portfolio expert, bringing market reality back into strategic decision-making.
* Portfolio strategy and lifecycle management
* Develop and maintain global portfolio strategies and roadmaps for all assigned pigment categories, aligned with Oterra’s growth ambitions, customer needs, and long-term strategic objectives.
* Manage the strategic interplay between pigments, identifying where products compete, complement, or create customer choice, and ensure the portfolio is positioned coherently across categories and regions.
* Lead portfolio optimization, including expansion, rationalization, lifecycle management, category prioritization, and discontinuation recommendations, supported by clear business cases.
* Simplify portfolio complexity by focusing resources on the highest-value opportunities while maintaining the right balance across pigment technologies, applications, and market segments.
* Performance, pricing, and value creation
* Own portfolio KPIs across assigned pigments, including growth, profitability, innovation effectiveness, market penetration, and achievement of strategic targets.
* Monitor performance by pigment category, region, and segment; identify growth and margin gaps; and lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions with Finance, Commercial, and regional teams.
* Develop pricing recommendations for new and existing products within the global pricing framework, considering value delivery, competitive benchmarks, substitution risk, discounting, and margin contribution.
* Build and maintain portfolio dashboards and fact-based review routines to support annual planning, portfolio reviews, pricing reviews, and executive decision-making.
* Innovation pipeline and investment prioritization
* Partner with Innovation, R&D, Commercial, Applications, and Marketing to define and prioritize the innovation pipeline across assigned pigments.
* Lead stage-gate submissions and investment recommendations, ensuring decisions are grounded in customer need, market attractiveness, technical feasibility, commercial potential, and expected returns.
* Balance near-term launches and longer-horizon innovation bets across pigments, making explicit prioritization choices and communicating trade-offs clearly.
* Define success metrics for innovation initiatives and track post-launch performance to improve future commercial outcomes and resource allocation.
* Cross-functional execution and commercial enablement
* Lead cross-functional execution of portfolio priorities across Commercial, R&D, Applications, Operations, Finance, Marketing, and regional teams.
* Align stakeholders on portfolio priorities, positioning, growth plans, pricing logic, and go-to-market execution for each pigment category.
* Enable successful commercialization through clear value propositions, launch support, customer-facing materials, and differentiated positioning tailored to each pigment.
* Remove barriers to delivery, maintain momentum across parallel workstreams, and escalate resource or investment decisions to the CPSO where required.

**Qualifications**  
  
**Experience & Background**  
  

* 8+ years of experience in product management, portfolio management, strategy, innovation, or commercial leadership within food ingredients, natural colors, flavors, specialty chemicals, or related industries.
* Demonstrated experience managing a multi-product or multi-category portfolio simultaneously, with clear accountability for performance across more than one product line.
* Technical familiarity with natural pigments - including plant extracts, fermentation-derived colorants, or microalgae - is a significant advantage; a genuine curiosity about color science and application technology is essential.
* Strong commercial acumen and proven understanding of portfolio economics, pricing, profitability, and value creation across complex product ranges.
* Experience influencing innovation investment decisions and managing product lifecycle strategies across multiple categories.
* Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into execution and measurable business results, managing multiple concurrent priorities without losing focus or quality.
* Experience managing performance through KPIs, dashboards, and structured business reviews in a matrixed, global organization.
* Proven track record of driving change and continuous improvement within complex, cross-functional environments.
* Continuous improvement mindset: familiarity with Lean, or similar methodologies is strongly preferred, with the ability to apply these principles to commercial and product management processes - not just operations.

**Skills & Competencies**  
  

* Able to hold expert-level knowledge across multiple pigments simultaneously while maintaining a coherent view of the overall portfolio - breadth and depth in equal measure.
* Strong analytical capabilities with a fact-based approach to decision making across a complex, multi-category product range.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distil multi-pigment portfolio complexity into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Highly organized and self-directed: comfortable managing multiple parallel workstreams across different pigment categories in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Collaborative and credible: able to work effectively across R&D, Commercial, Finance, Applications, and regional teams, and to influence without direct authority.
* Commercially curious: proactive in seeking out customer insight, competitive intelligence, and market trends across all assigned pigments.

**Education**  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.

**Travel**

job_description:
**Company Profile**  
The Carlyle Group (NASDAQ: CG) is a global investment firm with $475 billion of assets under management, across 678 investment vehicles as of March 31, 2026. Founded in 1987 in Washington, DC, Carlyle has grown into one of the world's largest and most successful investment firms, with more than 2,500 professionals operating in 28 offices in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Australia.  
  
Carlyle's purpose is to connect people, ideas, and capital to fuel growth for companies and performance for investors, which range from public and private pension funds to wealthy individuals and families to sovereign wealth funds, unions and corporations. Carlyle invests across three segments - Global Private Equity, Global Credit and Carlyle AlpInvest - and has deep expertise across industries, markets, and geographies.  
  
At Carlyle, we believe that a wide spectrum of experiences and viewpoints drives performance and success. Our CEO, Harvey Schwartz, has stated that, "To build better businesses and create value for all of our stakeholders, we are focused on assembling leadership teams with the strongest insights from a range of perspectives." Reflecting this view, emphasis is placed on development, retention and inclusion through our internal processes and seven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). We cultivate a culture where ideas are openly shared and challenged, connecting diverse expertise and perspectives to drive enduring value.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Carlyle is seeking a Product Manager to lead technology initiatives within Client Solutions Group Technology supporting the Firm's institutional fundraising and sales teams. This role will serve as the Product Manager for Salesforce, Carlyle's institutional sales and client relationship management platform, and will play a central role in the Firm's implementation of Salesforce and the broader modernization of the fundraising technology stack.  
  
The Product Manager will bridge business stakeholders and technology teams to design, implement, and evolve a scalable CRM platform that gives fundraising and sales teams a single, trusted view of investors and prospects, strengthens pipeline visibility and data quality, and drives commercial and operational efficiency.  
  
The ideal candidate will combine hands-on CRM product experience, outstanding relationship building and communication skills, and structured execution to deliver measurable business impact through implementation, launch, adoption, and ongoing product maturity.  
  
**In-Office Requirements:** 4 days per week in-office  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**  
Platform Strategy and Business Alignment

* Fundraising Platform Strategy: Partner with institutional sales, client coverage, product specialist, marketing, fund formation, and compliance teams to define and evolve the Salesforce roadmap across fundraising, coverage, and reporting use cases.
* Sales Process Enablement: Translate complex fundraising and coverage processes, including prospect targeting, pipeline management, capital commitments, and account coverage models, into streamlined, technology enabled workflows within Salesforce.
* Investor Data and Reporting: Own the investor and prospect data model, support the implementation of reusable data structures aligned with firm data governance standards, and ensure pipeline reporting and dashboards give leadership a trusted, near real time view of fundraising activity.
* Systems Integration: Collaborate with internal technology teams to ensure seamless integration between Salesforce and adjacent platforms, including investor onboarding, fund accounting, marketing automation, document management, and downstream reporting systems.

Product Ownership

* Lead the development, deployment, and enhancement of technology solutions tailored to fundraising and sales business needs, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
* Own day to day product management of Salesforce for the institutional sales user base through implementation, launch, and steady state operation.
* Lead the remaining phases of the Salesforce implementation, including requirements definition, data validation, testing, user training, and rollout.
* Define and manage the product roadmap, backlog, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritization, aligned to the Firm's fundraising and digitization objectives.
* Partner with engineering, implementation partners, and vendors to configure, test, and deploy new capabilities.
* Establish documentation, release, and enablement standards, and direct business analyst, quality assurance, and partner resources so that delivery scales beyond any single individual.

  

Adoption, Innovation, and Scalability

* Drive adoption across a senior, commercially focused sales user base, treating adoption as a product outcome rather than a training exercise.
* Improve the quality and completeness of investor, prospect, and pipeline data, and define the controls that keep it durable over time.
* Support scalable configurations and processes that can be reused across new funds, strategies, and investment segments.
* Define KPIs, monitor platform usage and performance, and recommend improvements that increase adoption, data quality, and commercial productivity.
* Identify and evaluate opportunities to incorporate AI and automation into fundraising and sales workflows, including data capture, activity logging, pipeline hygiene, and reporting, to enhance efficiency, insight, and the investor experience.

Stakeholder Management

* Act as a trusted advisor to senior sales and fundraising stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment between technical capabilities and commercial objectives.
* Mitigate risks by addressing potential delays and misalignments, ensuring projects remain on schedule and deliver high-impact outcomes.
* Provide structured updates to senior leadership on roadmap progress, implementation milestones, adoption metrics, risks, and key decisions.

**Key Deliverables**

* Successful implementation of Salesforce as the Firm's institutional sales platform.
* A trusted investor and prospect data set, with measurable gains in data quality and pipeline reporting accuracy.
* Streamlined workflows and seamless integration with adjacent systems, including investor onboarding, fund accounting, and marketing platforms.
* AI capabilities embedded in the fundraising platform that reimagine how the sales teams work, surfacing insight, removing manual effort, and helping coverage teams sell more effectively.
* Sustained adoption across the sales user base, measured by usage and data quality rather than rollout completion.
* A well documented platform with a support model that is not dependent on any single individual.

**Requirements**  
**Education & Certificates**

* Bachelor's Degree, required.
* Concentration in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Graduate-level degree preferred.

**Professional Experience**

* Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in product management or business analyst roles, preferably within Private Equity, Financial Services, or Technology.
* Hands-on experience owning or implementing a CRM platform, with Salesforce strongly preferred, including configuration, release management, and reporting.
* Experience leading or playing a central role in a CRM or enterprise platform implementation, including data validation, user training, and rollout.
* Familiarity with institutional fundraising, client coverage, or sales processes preferred; experience supporting a commercial or front office user base is a strong plus.
* Experience working with data analytics and business intelligence tools to generate insights, define KPIs, and support data driven decision making.
* Experience managing vendor platforms or SaaS implementations, and directing business analyst, quality assurance, or partner resources.
* Strong understanding of data management, governance, and integration frameworks.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

**Competencies & Attributes**

* Outstanding relationship building skills, with a track record of quickly earning trust and credibility with senior, commercially focused stakeholders and sustaining those relationships as a source of influence across a firm.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present with confidence to senior audiences and to translate fluently between technical and commercial language.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to design and implement technology solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to delegate and build capacity, scaling delivery through analysts, quality assurance, and partners rather than absorbing execution personally.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of new tools among demanding senior users, including automation, analytics, and AI-driven solutions.
* Sound prioritization judgment, distinguishing high volume core use cases from edge cases and sequencing work accordingly.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis and pivot tables.

**Benefits/Compensation**  
The compensation range for this role is specific to New York City and takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to the skill sets required/preferred; prior experience and training; licenses and/or certifications.  
  
The anticipated base salary range for this role is $160,000 to $180,000.  
  
In addition to the base salary, the hired professional will enjoy a comprehensive benefits package spanning retirement benefits, health insurance, life insurance and disability, paid time off, paid holidays, family planning benefits and various wellness programs. Additionally, the hired professional may also be eligible to participate in an annual discretionary incentive program, the award of which will be dependent on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.  
  
Due to the high volume of candidates, please be advised that only candidates selected to interview will be contacted by The Carlyle Group.

**Navigation Systems Product Owner — MagNav / Alternative PNT**

*SBQuantum · Full-time · Reports to the CTO · Onsite in Sherbrooke, Quebec*

**About SBQuantum**

SBQuantum builds diamond-based vectorial quantum magnetometers that, combined with AI-driven interpretation, deliver precision magnetic intelligence where GPS, radar, and sonar fail — enabling magnetic navigation (MagNav), anomaly detection, and mapping for defense, aerospace, autonomous systems, and space. We’re a 28-person team of physicists, engineers, and data scientists, with deep experience building and scaling products and companies and the teams behind them, recently funded and scaling. We’ve moved past the lab: sensors are sold and deployed with government customers, paid pilots are underway with defense and aerospace partners, and our sensing hardware is already orbiting the Earth in LEO.

**The Mission**

You will be our first dedicated navigation-systems hire — the architect who turns our quantum magnetometer into a navigation system. You’ll own the product design and roadmaps, get it integrated into drones, aircraft, and autonomous platforms. You report to the CTO, work shoulder-to-shoulder with our engineering and product development teams, our Director of Business Development, and our Joint-Development-Partners, and grow into the Product lead of the navigation team you’ll help build.

**What You’ll Do**

* Architect the end-to-end MagNav solution — define the product roadmap, building off the POC system, to version alpha and beyond, tailored to customer profiles.
* Set the technical requirements and roadmap — translate customer platform constraints (SWaP, dynamics, environment, cost) into our product roadmap, partnering with engineering and BD.
* Validate the roadmap with end users — setup user focus groups and keep product features closely aligned with the mission requirements.
* Drive integration on real platforms — define the hardware/firmware/software interfaces, work into drone-OEM and INS-maker guidance systems, and lead bench and flight-test campaigns.
* Be our product voice to customers — engage chief engineers credibly and help scope the joint development agreements and funded evaluations that carry us into their programs.
* Lay the foundation for the team — establish the design practices, tooling, and documentation the navigation group will scale on, and shape its first hires.

**First-Year Success**

* 30 days: Deep on our sensor and current navigation stack; an error-budget and gap analysis of today’s MagNav pipeline; alignment on the first target platform(s). Preliminary roadmap established.
* 90 days: A reference architecture for the productized MagNav navigation solution defined and bought into; compensation and filtering approach selected; a concrete integration plan for the first target platform. Roadmap fully established and validated with end clients.
* 6 months: A working navigation solution demonstrated on real or recorded flight data (or a bench/HIL setup); interfaces defined for at least one drone or INS integration; technically supporting at least one customer evaluation.
* 12 months: MagNav solution integrated and field/flight-tested on target platforms; finalized execution on the roadmap for first product release at a global event.

**What You Bring**

* Degree in aerospace, electrical, robotics, physics, or a related engineering field (MS/PhD a plus).
* ~8+ years designing navigation systems, including hands-on INS/IMU integration and sensor fusion (Kalman/EKF/UKF/particle filtering) for airborne, autonomous, or precision-guided platforms.
* You have personally owned at least one navigation system from architecture through integration to field or flight test on real hardware — not only simulation or research.
* Hands-on with at least one of: MagNav / magnetic-anomaly navigation, aeromagnetic compensation, or GPS-denied / alternative-PNT navigation.
* Comfortable close to hardware, firmware, and real-time/embedded constraints, and fluent working across the guidance / autopilot / mission-computer interface.
* Practitioner of modern systems engineering and architecture techniques (MBSE/SysML).
* Strong proficiency in the tools of the trade — MATLAB/Simulink, Python, and C/C++.
* A self-directed first-mover who can define the reference design as the only navigation architect in the room, not inherit one.
* Eligible to work under the applicable export-control regime (Canadian Controlled Goods Program and/or US ITAR/EAR) for defense navigation technical data.

**Nice to Have**

* Direct MagNav / magnetic-anomaly-navigation experience and work with geomagnetic or crustal anomaly maps (WMM/EMM).
* Magnetometry, quantum sensing, OPM, or NV-diamond exposure.
* Drone autopilot ecosystems (PX4/ArduPilot) or defense GNC / missile navigation.
* Experience with specific MBSE/SysML tools (e.g., Capella, Cameo, or similar) and the ability to tailor their use to a dynamic startup environment.
* Flight-test or field-test campaign experience.
* Active or prior security clearance (US or Canadian), or eligibility.
* Startup or first-technical-hire experience; patents or publications in navigation or magnetics.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Base and performance bonus with meaningful early-employee equity as well as health benefits, flexible vacation, and a professional-development budget.

**Why Join**

GPS-denied navigation is one of the most urgent unsolved problems in defense, and magnetic navigation is one of the most credible answers. We have working sensors — hardware already flying in LEO — government customers, and paid pilots with defense and aerospace partners. What we don’t have yet is the person who turns that sensor into a navigation system. That’s this job, with the ownership, equity, and growth path to match.

*SBQuantum is mission-driven and welcomes people independently of gender, race, beliefs, citizenship status where legally permissible, and orientation — and we value unconventional paths. Let’s meet.*

job_description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.  
  
Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.  
  
As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.  
  
We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.  
  
Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction  
  

* Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.
* Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.
* The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.
* PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.
* We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.
* This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.

Location  
  

* Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (Monday, Wednesday and Friday in-office). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

Role Overview  
  

* We're hiring a Product Manager, Applied AI to own PermitFlow's core AI infrastructure and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel.
* Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow.
* In this context, you will be asked to deeply familiarize yourself with PermitFlow’s users, customers and use-cases, so you can develop a blended strategy, supporting single-shot full automation where possible and utilizing human-in-the-loop patterns where human judgment is still required. This is not an incremental role, we are looking for someone who can have a major impact in how fast construction gets done in America, Canada and beyond.
* The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build.
* This role reports directly to our Head of Product. We're hiring at Staff or Senior Staff, with the level based on past experience and interview performance.

What You’ll Do  
  
You will operate across agent design, evaluation, and operational execution:  
  

* Deliver our core set of workflow agents for permitting, enabling rapid comprehension of construction projects and accurate compliance submissions for permits and inspections
* Define what "reliable enough to submit" means at both the field and submission level, and own the quality bar that gates release
* Own our path to full automation, segmenting use cases and driving to single-shot submission where accuracy allows
* Design the architecture for assistive use cases, building the agents and tools that empower permit coordinators to move faster where humans-in-the-loop is the best solution
* Work with our operations org to build an evaluation and data flywheel through early testing, golden data set generation, and structured error analysis ahead of submission
* Build a durable design system around our data flywheel, ensuring that users can easily provide feedback on our Agents & AI products
* Build the internal toolset for testing, error analysis, and hill climbing that every team at PermitFlow uses to ship agentic work
* Serve as the internal applied AI expert for teams coming from more traditional software backgrounds

What We’re Looking For  
  
We're looking for product leaders who have shipped AI into production in domains where accuracy carries real-world consequences.  
  

* 7+ years of product management experience, or an equivalent track record in forward deployed engineering, applied research, or operations leadership
* Direct ownership of the quality bar for a shipped AI/Agentic system
* Hands-on experience building evaluations, including experience with golden data sets, LLM-as-judge, human annotation, and online monitoring
* Judgment on when to build an agent and when a simpler product or process change delivers more
* Deep technical fluency and comfortable engaging engineering on technical concepts
* Track record of partnering closely with operations teams and translating operational insight into product
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and create clarity for cross-functional teams
* High sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability
* Track record of high quality delivery and increased scope across multiple roles

What We Offer  
  

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company
* 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA
* 401(k) savings plan
* Unlimited PTO and paid family leave
* Home office & equipment stipend
* Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided
* Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

Closing  
  
If you’re excited by the opportunity to build AI-powered products that simplify complex real-world workflows - and want to help define a category from the ground up - we’d love to talk.

* Experience working proposals and writing basis-of-estimates (BOEs) for software efforts

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar
* Prior experience as a Product Owner
* Prior experience working within an Agile Release Train (larger software development effort composed of multiple scrum teams working towards common goals over Program Increments)

* Ability to effectively write technical documentation
* Ability to travel (very limited, 1 to 4 short trips per year, less than 10%)

The Data Product Owner plays a critical role in driving the success of data products that power strategic decision-making across the organization. This individual will define, develop, and manage data products that enable high-quality, secure, and accessible data, ensuring alignment with business priorities and regulatory requirements. By bridging the gap between business, data engineering, and governance teams, the Data Product Owner will help unlock actionable insights that enhance customer experience, optimize financial performance, and streamline operations.

  

Responsibilities:

* Define and execute a data product roadmap that supports customer insights, financial intelligence, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify high-value data opportunities and transform them into scalable products.
* Prioritize data product features and enhancements based on business impact, feasibility, and compliance requirements.
* Advocate for data as a product, ensuring accessibility and usability across the organization.
* Partner with the business to establish governance policies, data definitions, and quality controls that drive trust in data.
* Define and enforce data SLAs (Service Level Agreements), lineage, and metadata management to ensure consistent data usability.
* Ensure data products comply with HIPAA and other relevant healthcare regulations while maintaining high data integrity and security.
* Act as the primary liaison between RDT data engineers, business leaders, analysts, and platform teams to ensure seamless implementation of data products.
* Work closely with the Global RDT data platform team to integrate self-serve analytics capabilities, enabling faster and more informed decision-making.
* Champion data democratization, ensuring the right data reaches the right users in a secure, governed, and intuitive timely manner.
* Define and track KPIs for data product performance, adoption, and business impact.
* Use data-driven insights to continuously improve data products and ensure they align with evolving business needs.
* Stay ahead of industry trends in data mesh, AI-driven analytics, and healthcare data innovation to drive future growth.

  

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or other related field or equivalent work experience
* 5+ years of experience in data product management, data governance, or data engineering, preferably in healthcare, life sciences, or diagnostics.

Preferred Requirements:

* 5+ years of experience managing enterprise data assets and products that directly enhance operational efficiency, customer insights, and strategic business/financial decision-making.
* Proven ability to translate complex business needs into clear technical requirements and specifications, acting as a strategic bridge to communicate the value of data across all levels of the organization.

**About Breakout Learning**

Breakout Learning is building the future of education by putting meaningful conversation and critical thinking back at the center of learning. We bring together instructional design, artificial intelligence, and world-class content to create learning experiences that are engaging, rigorous, and built for the way people learn now.

We believe AI can do more than deliver information. Used thoughtfully, it can help people think better, act faster, and develop capabilities that were previously difficult to teach at scale. This new business line will extend that belief beyond the classroom through high-touch, practical coaching experiences.

**The Opportunity**

AI is moving quickly, but most leaders do not need another stream of tools, headlines, or generic training. They need help understanding what matters, applying it to real work, and building durable new habits.

You will create that experience from the ground up. The initial product will be highly personal and service-led, allowing us to learn deeply from clients and prove outcomes. Your job is to turn those insights into a clear methodology, a compelling product, and a scalable operating model without losing the quality and trust that make coaching effective.

This is not a traditional product role where strategy is handed to another team for execution. You will own the work from first client conversation through delivery, measurement, iteration, and scale.

**What You Will Own**

**Product and business-line leadership**

* Set the vision, strategy, positioning, roadmap, and success measures for the new business line.
* Design the core offer, including diagnostics, coaching journeys, learning assets, AI-enabled experiences, and ongoing client support.

* Create an experience that is rigorous, personalized, candid, and immediately useful.

**Customer discovery and growth**

* Partner closely with the CEO on customer discovery, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.

**Operations and scale**

* Use AI tools and agentic workflows to improve research, personalization, coaching preparation, client support, and internal operations.
* Develop the playbooks, training, quality assurance, and certification standards needed to expand delivery beyond a single operator.

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 90 days**

* Establish a clear product thesis, initial customer profile, coaching methodology, and measurement framework.
* Deliver the experience personally to early clients and create a fast, disciplined learning loop.
* Identify the strongest sources of client value, the biggest friction points, and the most important product assumptions to test.

**Within six months**

* Demonstrate meaningful client outcomes and strong signals in retention, referrals, and willingness to pay.
* Build a repeatable client journey with clear standards, core assets, operating rhythms, and healthy unit economics.
* Produce a grounded roadmap for technology enablement and responsible scaling.

**Within twelve months**

* Establish a differentiated, credible business line with a clear market position and evidence of product-market fit.
* Build the systems and initial team required to grow without diluting coaching quality or client trust.
* Create a durable product-development engine in which every client engagement improves the offer, methodology, and operating model.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Commercial ownership and operating style**

* Comfort owning commercial outcomes, business performance, or a P&L, including pricing, capacity, and unit economics.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complexity without flattening it.
* A builder’s mindset: strategic enough to see the whole system and hands-on enough to do the work yourself.

**How You Work**

* You start with the client and stay close to the work.
* You move quickly without becoming careless.

* You are energized by ambiguity, but you do not leave it ambiguous for long.

What We Do Yesterday's insurance wasn't built for today's risk. We see it in the data and we feel it in the field. Emerging technology can reinvent how risk is priced and managed, faster and smarter, anchored in proven expertise. First-movers will define the next era of commercial risk management, and Shepherd is building it. Shepherd is a technology-driven Managing General Underwriter (MGU) transforming commercial Property & Casualty insurance for high-hazard industries. Our mission is to make risk frictionless for the builders and operators shaping the physical world, protecting progress from concept through construction and into decades of operation. We're building the fastest, smartest commercial risk platform, where underwriting expertise, data, and automation work together to deliver: Faster decisions Smarter, more accurate pricing Better risk outcomes With Shepherd, safety, speed, and quality no longer trade off against one another. They compound. We're not just modernizing insurance products. We're building the risk infrastructure for the next generation of financial services, where technology, underwriting, and partnerships operate in harmony to support the world's most important industries and the progress they make possible. Our Investors In March 2026, Shepherd raised a $42M Series B — bringing total funding to over $60M — led by Intact Private Capital, the investment arm of one of the largest insurers in the world. Intact is not only our lead investor but also a carrier partner, a testament to the confidence the incumbent industry has in what we're building. Our investors: Intact Private Capital, led our Series B round Costanoa Ventures, led our Series A round Spark Capital, led our Seed round Susa Ventures, lead our Pre-Seed round Y Combinator And several others Our Team We're a team of technologists and insurance enthusiasts, bridging the two worlds together. Check out our About page to learn more. You'll be supporting the Nova Team Nova is the team building fully autonomous underwriting. A broker wants coverage for a construction project and emails us a pile of documents: an application, years of claims history, a spreadsheet of what's being built and what it costs, payroll records, prior policies, and a note with the real context buried in the third paragraph. No two brokers send the same thing. An underwriter reads all of it, pulls out a few hundred facts, judges how risky the project is, and prices it. Nova does that work end to end, with agents that read the documents, extract and reconcile the facts, chase down what's missing, and hand back a priced account. We structure the roadmap as an autonomy ladder borrowed from self-driving. L1 is a human doing the job with assistance. L5 is an email arriving and a priced policy coming out with nobody in between. We're in the middle, and progress means expanding the set of accounts the system handles unsupervised. The business case is straightforward: our long term vision has a single underwriter overseeing roughly 10x the accounts they handle today, with the system doing intake, analysis, and pricing while the person sets strategy and works exceptions. Getting there is largely a measurement challenge. An account only counts as autonomous if everything on it is right, which makes this a compounding problem rather than an average one, and much of the roadmap comes down to how we define and measure that. About the Role We're looking for an exceptional, entrepreneurial technical product manager to own the roadmap, execution, discovery, and vision for Nova, and to help define what autonomous underwriting looks like for the whole industry. This is Nova's first product hire. The team is small, extremely high caliber, and growing. The engineers here have taken autonomous underwriting from an idea to real prices on real accounts, making the product calls themselves along the way. You'd be joining people who know this problem cold and who will expect you to get there fast. This role sits alongside leadership and at the intersection of three domain expertises: engineers who think in eval runs and retrieval quality, underwriters with decades of pricing judgment, and leadership setting the direction of the business. One day you're aligning with our CTO on the autonomy roadmap and pressure-testing the thesis with the leadership team; the next you're pairing with an engineer on a new extraction flow and putting a working version in front of an underwriter before the day ends. Each group holds part of the answer, the best ideas come out of the overlap, and you'll be the person who creates it. If you want to build a category-defining product with real executive air cover and no ceiling on your impact, this is the seat. The person who does well here is closer to a founder than to a traditional PM. This is an environment for people who need intellectual challenge, thrive in progress, and are motivated by the impact of their work. What you'll do Own the product end to end. Vision, discovery, prioritization, execution, and the UX and design decisions along the way. Prioritize ruthlessly, be as clear about what we're not building as what we are, and shape how we staff design and engineering against the roadmap. You're accountable for results rather than shipped features: adoption by our underwriters, how much of the work runs without a person, how accurate it is, and whether we can win a deal on a fully autonomous motion. Understand the user deeply. Sit with underwriters, read submissions yourself, and build the instinct for why one contractor's paperwork is far harder to handle than another's. Find the places where the system can make their work faster, more reliable, and more complete, and turn that into requirements and edge case coverage. Own the definition of correct. Our eval framework is effectively the product spec. You'll shape what gets measured, where materiality thresholds sit, which regressions block a release, and how field-level results roll up into claims we're willing to make publicly. Set the bar for what autonomous means at Shepherd. How our agents reason, when they act on their own, when they defer, and how they earn an underwriter's trust. Autonomy is only useful if the escalation path is trustworthy, so you'll own how uncertainty gets surfaced and what a person sees when the system hands something back. Ship fast with engineering. You'll write prompts, dig through eval data, and pull the failing runs to work out whether a problem is retrieval, model behavior, or how we've modeled the data, all before filing a ticket. Use AI coding agents to prototype, validate, and unblock, and write code yourself when that's the quickest path, without letting the quality bar slip. Who you are Hungry, with the track record to back it. 4+ years in product, and you've owned the direction of a hard technical product and can point to what came of it. We care about what you've built and how fast you move more than how many years you've been at it. Technical in practice. You can read a PR, contribute in an architecture discussion, write your own SQL, and reason about why a model behaves the way it does. You've built things, at work or on your own. You've shipped AI into production. You know the difference between a demo and a system people rely on, and you have informed opinions about evals and model quality. Statistically literate. You're comfortable reasoning about distributions and thresholds, and you interrogate a metric before you trust it. Willing to go deep on the domain. Understanding construction risk well enough to encode it is most of the advantage here. If learning an unfamiliar industry in detail sounds tedious rather than interesting, this won't be a good fit. A direct communicator. You write clearly, you disagree in the room, and you don't need a deck to make a decision. Opinionated, high agency, experimental. You form a point of view and argue for it. You don't wait to be handed work. Your instinct when something is unclear is to run the experiment rather than debate it. There's no playbook and no product org to lean on here, so you'll define how product works and change it as the team grows. Nice to have Background in autonomy, robotics, or another field where escalation and graduated trust are core concepts Document AI, information extraction, or agentic workflow experience Time in insurance, fintech, or another regulated industry Founder or early-employee experience Hands-on with eval tooling and experiment tracking How we work Shepherd runs on four values. Here's what each one means in this seat. Think big, build big. We exist to protect progress and the industries that rely on it. The work here is aimed at a system that runs on its own, and the roadmap gets sequenced backward from that rather than forward from what's easy. Win together. We rise as one. We support each other, raise the bar, and celebrate collective success. As the first PM you set a standard the rest of the team inherits, and the milestones belong to the team rather than to product. Cross the aisle. Collaboration wins. We listen deeply, work across boundaries, and prioritize shared success over individual lanes. The best product calls here come from engineers who've sat with underwriters and underwriters who understand where the model breaks, and much of this job is listening closely enough on both sides to make that happen. Go get it. We act with urgency, move with confidence, take smart risks, and push forward with intention. Nobody hands you the roadmap, the data, or the meeting invite. You pull the failing runs, book the time with the underwriters, and decide what matters. Benefits Premium Healthcare 100% contribution to top-tier health, dental, and vision Fertility benefits and family building support ️ Unlimited PTO Flexibility to take the time off, recharge, and perform Daily lunches, dinners, and snacks We work together, and enjoy meals together too ️ SF, NYC, Dallas-Fort Worth, Chicago and LA Offices Professional Development Access to premium coaching, including leadership development Competitive 401(k) Plan Dog-friendly office Plenty of dogs to play with and make friends with in the SF office

job_title: Director, Oncology Commercial Data Science & AI Products
job_description:
### We're building a connected, end-to-end Enterprise AI engine - uniting data foundations, AI technology, process reinvention, and business-facing AI to accelerate results across the whole value chain. Success depends on being exceptional connectors: you'll actively leverage existing capabilities, celebrate and promote reuse, export breakthrough ideas across geographies and functions, and obsess over scaling impact rather than building in isolation. If you thrive in high-collaboration environments where your role is to turn complex, cross-functional problems into reusable, enterprise-wide capabilities - and where the measure of success is adoption and scale, not just innovation - you'll have the platform (and sponsorship) to make it real.

  

### Our DS&AI Products team is the OBU's in-house engine for that work. We lead all aspects of the full lifecycle of AI-powered applications spanning predictive field triggers, patient-identification models, omnichannel next-best-action, KOL intelligence, and GenAI-powered field tools — and we ship products, not reports. Every capability we build must deliver measurable field adoption and commercial impact.

  

### We are hiring a Director, DS&AI Products who will lead a multi-indication AI product portfolio end-to-end, serve as the strategic DS&AI business partner to OBU brand and medical leadership, and lead the responsible design, delivery, adoption, and impact measurement of AI solutions that drive commercial lift and better patient outcomes.

  

### Role overview

### This is a product ownership and program strategy role — not an analytics consulting role. You lead the full AI product lifecycle: problem definition, customer research, product requirements, AI development partnership, UX design alignment, deployment, change management, and post-launch impact measurement. You are the product owner and strategist for the AI capabilities powering Sales, Marketing, and Medical Affairs across your assigned OBU tumor areas, and the liaison US Oncology and the broader AstraZeneca Enterprise AI organization for customer engagement capability building.

### You will be equally comfortable writing a product requirements document, reviewing a GenAI architecture with an engineering lead, running a discovery session with brand managers, delivering the AI transformation narrative to field sales leadership and presenting a capability roadmap to the Senior Leadership Teams. You will bring a platform-centric, reuse-first mindset: every solution you ship should be architected for scalability and accelerated deployment across indications - so a trigger framework proven in one tumor area becomes the template for the next launch.

  

Key responsibilities
--------------------

  

### 1. Program Strategy & AI Roadmap Ownership

* ### Own the strategy and transformation roadmap for Sales, Marketing, and Medical Affairs AI capabilities across your assigned OBU tumor-area portfolio, being responsible for planning and budget management processes in alignment with OBU annual cycle.
* ### Develop quantifiable cases and value narratives for future Sales, Marketing, and field AI capabilities in collaboration with OBU Franchises, I&A, and Enterprise AI delivery teams; present to OBU Leadership Team (OLT) to drive top-down alignment and shared decisions on roadmap prioritization.
* ### Maintain a prioritized product backlog with well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery timelines; balance the portfolio across housekeeping (maintenance/refresh), innovation (new AI capability pilots), and new-indication onboarding in an agile operating model.
* ### Track industry, market, and innovation shifts — GenAI, agentic AI, oncology data science, competitor AI strategies — to anticipate opportunities and risks and keep the roadmap forward-looking.
* ### Champion a platform-centric, reuse-first architecture philosophy: design AI capabilities that pilot in one indication and scale across OBUs without re-platforming.

  

### 2. GenAI & Agentic AI Product Development

* ### Lead the definition, design, and delivery of GenAI-powered applications for OBU commercial and medical teams: AI-assisted field briefing tools (InsightIQ), clinical evidence summarization for MSLs, agentic omnichannel workflows (Engagement IQ), and natural-language interfaces to AZBrain analytics.
* ### Define product requirements and functional specifications for LLM-powered, RAG-based, and agentic AI applications; partner with Enterprise AI engineering leads to translate requirements into governed, scalable, production-grade solutions.
* ### Maintain solid understanding of the evolving GenAI / agentic AI landscape — prompt engineering, RAG architectures, multi-agent orchestration, evals — and critically evaluate architecture choices against OBU field workflow requirements.
* ### Apply rigorous pilot-and-scale methodology: define pilot scope and success criteria upfront, measure output quality and user adoption, and drive evidence-based scaling decisions to other indications and OBU functions.

  

### 3. DS&AI Business Partnership — Brand, Medical & Access

* ### DS&AI business partner and product owner for assigned tumor-area brand teams, Medical Affairs, and Market Access — attending strategy reviews, launches, and leadership committee meetings as the AI expert at the table.
* ### Lead cross-functional discovery workshops that reveal unmet decision needs. Develop well-scoped AI use cases using detailed problem descriptions, success metrics, data requirements, and risk tiers. Convert the results into actionable user stories for engineering teams.
* ### Partner with MSL and medical leadership on scientific use cases: treatment-pathway analytics, KOL/KEE influence mapping (Cami constellation), diagnostics/biomarker testing strategies and health equity analytics.
* ### Own and govern demand-sensing and care-gap workstreams feeding FSIP, forecasting, and field strategy plans; present roadmap and field impact at leadership team meetings, national sales meetings, and SteerCo forums.

  

### 4. Capability Building & Change Management

* ### Set the direction for how OBU develops AI functions in Sales, Marketing, and Medical Affairs. Prioritize solutions that meet key business needs. Ensure these solutions are scalable, balanced, and embedded in daily field workflows.
* ### Identify the people and process changes required to successfully stand up each AI capability; act as change leader, delivering the organizational AI transformation narrative to sales and marketing teams.
* ### Partner with Business Excellence and Franchise teams to design and execute training plans, field enablement workshops, and persona-aligned onboarding for every major capability release.
* ### Drive AI literacy across brand, medical, and field teams through capability reviews, lunch-and-learns, and executive presentations; build self-service fluency with AZ AI platforms.

  

### 5. Execution Excellence & Delivery Accountability

* ### Ensure accurate and timely translation of business needs into technical requirements. Partner with the AI division passionate about enterprise solutions in data science and engineering. Establish clear RACI and maintain alignment on priorities, dependencies, and timelines across the full delivery model.
* ### Drive launch-critical AI results on time: pre-launch analytics, ML-enriched targeting lists, EHR/claims/lab-signal predictive triggers per AIDLC framework.
* ### Supervise progress and surface interdependencies across the product portfolio; creatively address key challenges and blockers and escalate to senior leadership with clear problem framing and proposed solutions.
* ### Manage external vendors and consulting partners against defined deliverables and timelines; support budget management and PMO invoicing.

  

### 6. AI Innovation, Data Science & Emerging Capabilities

* ### Identify and pilot emerging AI/ML techniques for the OBU portfolio: LLM-powered field tools, agentic frameworks, biomarker-signal models, multimodal data fusion (structured claims + unstructured clinical notes + lab signals), and RWE analytics.
* ### Lead or co-lead data-source evaluations; articulate granularity caveats and preprocessing requirements to both technical and business audiences.
* ### Design and implement the OBU predictive ML trigger ecosystem for earlier patient identification across indications, with reusable frameworks that scale across tumor areas.
* ### Drive precision-medicine and earlier-patient-identification strategies: design AI trigger frameworks that detect high-risk patients upstream of clinical decision points, reducing diagnostic and treatment lag.

  

### 7. AI Governance, Compliance & Data Stewardship

* ### Operate within AstraZeneca's enterprise AI governance framework: registry-before-scale, model and data cards, human-in-the-loop oversight, ongoing monitoring, and IT approval processes.

- Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.
- Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.
- The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.
- PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.
- We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.
- This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.

- We're hiring a Product Manager, Applied AI to own PermitFlow's core AI infrastructure and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel.
- Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow.
- In this context, you will be asked to deeply familiarize yourself with PermitFlow’s users, customers and use-cases, so you can develop a blended strategy, supporting single-shot full automation where possible and utilizing human-in-the-loop patterns where human judgment is still required. - Deliver our core set of workflow agents for permitting, enabling rapid comprehension of construction projects and accurate compliance submissions for permits and inspections
- Define what "reliable enough to submit" means at both the field and submission level, and own the quality bar that gates release
