job_title: Lead Product Manager - Agreement Manager Search
job_description:
**Company Overview**  
  
Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  
  
What you'll do  
  
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to lead the search and discovery experience for Docusign Agreement Manager. In this role, you will own the end-to-end user experience for how customers search, browse, and act on agreements in Agreement Manager, with a strong focus on usability, Al-first experiences, and measurable business impact. You will be responsible for improving core search quality and relevance, defining and tracking key metrics, and stitching together a cohesive experience across search, chat, and worksheets to help customers ask questions and get trusted answers from their agreements.  
  
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Product Management.  
  
**Responsibility**  
  

* Own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for search and discovery within Docusign Agreement Manager, aligned to the broader IAM platform strategy
* Lead the user experience for how customers search, filter, sort, and explore agreements in Agreement Manager, partnering closely with Design and Research to deliver intuitive, delightful workflows
* Improve search quality and relevance through experimentation, ranking, and result presentation; define KPIs, implement tracking, and use data to continuously refine the experience
* Define and deliver cohesive workflows that connect search, chat, and worksheets so customers can ask natural language questions, get answers, and take action in one integrated experience
* Partner with Al, Search, and Engineering teams to bring Al-first features to market, including natural language search, conversational query experiences, and proactive recommendations
* Work closely with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders (including Sales, Customer Success, Support, and GTM teams) to identify problems, validate solutions, and drive adoption of search- and Al-led workflows

Job Designation  
  
**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)  
  
Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  
  
What you bring  
  
**Basic**  
  

* 12+ years of related product management experience for SaaS products and services, or 8+ years with a Master's degree, including meaningful ownership of user-facing search or discovery experiences
* Experience building and iterating on data- and metrics-driven products, including defining KPIs, instrumenting telemetry, and running experiments to improve outcomes
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product Management, Design, Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Program Management, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support
* Experience leading complex, user-facing initiatives end to end from problem discovery and concept validation through launch and post-launch iteration

**Preferred**  
  

* Experience with search, information retrieval, or discovery products (for example, enterprise search, content repositories, analytics/workspace tools, or knowledge management systems)
* Experience with Al/ML-powered user experiences such as natural language search, conversational interfaces, recommendations, or semantic search
* Experience with B2B or enterprise SaaS products serving large organizations
* Experience working directly with customers and field teams (Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Support, GTM) to understand use cases, validate solutions, and drive adoption
* Strong user experience sensibility with a track record of partnering closely with Design and Research to shape delightful end-to-end workflows
* Analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to align strategy, customer needs, research, data, and industry trends
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively in a matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders and priorities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate product strategy, requirements, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences

Wage Transparency  
  
Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  
  
Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations:  
  
California: $186,100.00 - $300,550.00 base salary  
  
Illinois, Colorado, Massachusetts and Minnesota: $178,900.00 - $252,700.00 base salary  
  
Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $178,900.00 - $262,825.00 base salary  
  
**This Role Is Also Eligible For The Following**  
  

* Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre-established sales goals. Non-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance.
* Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

**Benefits**  
  
Global benefits provide options for the following:  
  

* Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region
* Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement
* Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment
* Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions
* Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements
* Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life-changing events

Life at Docusign  
  
**Working here**  
  
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  
  
We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.  
  
**Accommodation**  
  
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  
  
If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

job_title: Product Manager - Commodities - Mesa, AZ or Denver, CO
job_description:
Founded in Denver in 1987, QED aims to provide high-quality electrical products and services to the industry. QED employs over 500 associates across 18 branches within Arizona and Colorado to serve commercial and residential contractors, industrial facilities, and OEM businesses.  
  
At QED, we embrace what makes us unique. As a company with local roots and global reach, we excel at the diversity of our Associates and the different ways each of us contributes to our success. What keeps us at the forefront of progress? OUR PEOPLE. No matter where they work or who they are, we trust their individual skills and qualities and give them everything they need to reach their full potential.  
  
**Position Summary**  
  
The Product Manager - Commodities is responsible for driving profitable commodity growth for the organization, with the primary focus on large and complex wire and conduit opportunities. The position manages quote opportunities and awarded commodity sales orders by working closely with the Director of Purchasing, partner vendors, QED Operations leadership, and the sales department to ensure customer needs are met while maintaining profitability.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  

* Collaborate, develop, and execute a comprehensive commodity category strategy aligned with company objectives.
* Monitor market dynamics including commodity trends (e.g., copper, steel, pvc) and supply chain risks
* Stakeholder in strategic supplier relationships, including negotiations, contracts, rebates, and long-term partnership agreements
* Drive sourcing initiatives to improve total landed cost, margin performance and working capital efficiency.
* Coordinate, prepare, and close commodity opportunities in response to RFQs
* Partner with the sales team to book orders based on market feedback, customer needs, and vendor support
* Manage commodity orders from PO through final fulfillment
* Serve as the local expert for commodity services and solutions
* Promote and develop new services to differentiate QED Electric in the marketplaces that we serve.
* Analyze competitor products, services, and pricing to identify strategic opportunities
* Build strong relationships with the sales teams, branch managers, and regional sales leadership
* Oversee purchasing activities to ensure efficient and cost-effective acquisition of goods and services
* Update Purchase Orders as shipments arrive and resolve discrepancies
* Monitor inventory levels to prevent shortages or overstock situations
* Evaluate supplier performance across pricing, service levels, lead times, quality, and innovation.
* Leverage date and analytics to track category performance, supplier metrics, inventory turns, and overall financial outcomes

**Qualifications**  
  
**Education & Experience**  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field required.
* Proven performance and results driven leadership
* 5–8+ years of experience in commodity category management, strategic sourcing, or procurement, preferably within electrical distribution, manufacturing, or industrial supply.
* Experience managing electrical product categories such as wire & cable preferred.

**Knowledge & Skills**  
  

* Strong understanding of electrical products, supply markets, and industry dynamics.
* Data driven decision making
* Proven negotiation and supplier management skills.
* Verbal and written communication skills
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* High level of integrity and ability to build effective relationships
* Proven ability to implement and influence change across functional groups
* Proficiency with ERP systems and advanced Excel or analytics tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Experience working in a multi-branch or multi-region electrical distribution environment
* Exposure to national supplier programs and rebate structures

**Location: Mesa, AZ or Denver, CO**  
  
**Compensation: $90,000 - 120,000**

* Healthcare plans
* Dental & vision
* Paid time off
* Paid parental leave
* 401(k) retirement savings with company match
* Professional and personal development programs
* Opportunity to become a shareholder

* Employer-paid life insurance for spouse and dependents
* Robust wellness program
* Gym reimbursement
* Employee Referral Program

The *Product Manager – Luxury Outdoor Kitchen* is our pivotal product champion responsible for leading the development and lifecycle of product innovation to drive growth across our our outdoor lifestyle brand, Lynx.

This role identifies high-impact innovation opportunities that align with the company's growth strategy, evolving consumer needs, and market trends while delivering differentiated value propositions.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, consumer-focused product leader who combines business acumen, analytical thinking, and collaborative leadership to deliver meaningful value to customers and the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Manage Category Portfolio, P&L, and Roadmap:** Lead category portfolio strategy, product roadmap, revenue, margin, and cost management across Luxury Outdoor Kitchen, partnering with key stakeholders to drive sustainable growth and ensure the portfolio remains commercially robust.
* **Drive Category, Competitor & Consumer Insights:** Translate consumer research, market trends, competitor analysis into actionable product strategies, differentiated propositions and future-state roadmap priorities.
* **Champion End-to-End NPI:** Lead NPI development and champion the tollgate process from project definition, proposition development, portfolio and PIPO strategy, and business case validation to launch management and post-launch optimization.
* **Drive Lifecycle Management & Transitions:** Lead portfolio and line reviews to define phase-in/phase-out plans, including assortment decisions, inventory transitions, last-time buys, replacement mapping, customer communication, and end-of-life risk mitigation.
* **Develop Product Positioning and Messaging:** Translate product capabilities, customer needs, and competitive context into clear, differentiated value propositions for target customer.
* **Launch Management:** Facilitate key milestones and hand-offs between Engineers, Suppliers and Brand Marketing to meet launch timeline and develop Marketing Introduction Guide to support marketing development sales enablement, and training for successful product introductions.
* **Define Channel-Product Strategy:** Partner with Sales and Marketing teams to align product assortment, positioning, launch priorities to enable channel growth.
* **Post-Launch Hyper Care:** Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs), including revenue, gross margin, market share, and customer satisfaction, recommending improvements as needed.

Requirements

* 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Marketing, Innovation Management, or related roles.
* Experience leading new product development from concept through commercialization.
* Strong financial acumen.
* Experience in outdoor appliances or durables preferred.

As a **Senior Manager, Product Launch** at Vynamic, you will serve as a trusted advisor to life sciences clients, leading complex product launch and commercialization engagements from strategy through execution. You will partner with senior client stakeholders to define launch strategies, establish governance, optimize operating models, and guide cross-functional execution across the commercialization lifecycle.  
  
As the engagement leader, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional client outcomes while coaching consulting teams, cultivating client relationships, contributing to business development, and advancing Vynamic's Product Launch capabilities.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
  

* Lead Product Launch Engagements: Serve as the engagement lead for strategic product launch consulting engagements, ensuring high-quality delivery, strong team performance, and exceptional client outcomes.
* Executive Client Partnership: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, providing strategic guidance throughout the commercialization lifecycle.
* Launch Strategy & Readiness: Design and lead integrated launch strategies, launch readiness assessments, governance models, and cross-functional planning efforts that enable successful product launches.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other client functions to align priorities and drive execution.
* Strategic Analysis & Recommendations: Be mindful of and understand market dynamics, competitive intelligence, customer insights, and organizational capabilities to develop actionable recommendations.
* Project Leadership & Risk Management: Lead engagement planning, proactively manage risks and issues, facilitate executive decision-making, and ensure successful project execution.
* People Development: Mentor and coach consultants, providing ongoing feedback and creating opportunities for professional growth.
* Business Development: Support proposal development, thought leadership, and client relationship expansion to grow Vynamic's Product Launch practice.
* Practice Development: Contribute to methodologies, intellectual capital, and best practices that strengthen Vynamic's commercialization and launch offerings.
* Inclusive Leadership: Foster an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and collaboration drives innovative client solutions.

**Qualifications**  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA, MS, PharmD, PhD, or other advanced degree preferred.
* 6+ years of experience in life sciences consulting or the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry, with significant experience leading product launch, commercialization, or launch excellence initiatives.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple product launches from strategy through execution.
* Deep understanding of launch planning, commercialization strategy, launch readiness, governance, and cross-functional operating models.
* Experience partnering with Commercial, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Executive Leadership teams.
* Proven ability to lead complex consulting engagements, manage multiple workstreams, and oversee project financials.
* Experience developing client relationships and contributing to business development, proposal writing, and account growth.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and team development experience.

**Why Join Vynamic?**  
  
At Vynamic, we believe in leading with authenticity, purpose, and passion. As a **Senior Manager, Product Launch**, you'll help life sciences organizations successfully bring innovative therapies and technologies to market while inspiring commercial, scientific, and operational excellence. You'll work alongside talented colleagues in a collaborative, values-driven environment where your expertise will shape client success, advance our Product Launch capabilities, and contribute to meaningful change across the life sciences industry.  
  
Ready to make an impact? Join Vynamic and be part of a team where your leadership, product launch expertise, and passion for improving healthcare will thrive and grow  
  
**Inizio Ignite, Vynamic**  
  
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. We partner with leading health and life science companies serving brand & commercial, Medical Affairs, R&D, and Health Services. From early-stage development to loss of exclusivity, we simplify complexity, unlock value, and make collaboration seamless at every pivotal moment – supporting confident, insight-driven decisions that move innovation forward.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. This range may differ based on your experience and skill set, geographic location, and cost of living considerations. $140,000—$160,000 USD

job_title: Senior Global Product Manager, Enabling Technologies
job_description:
**Who We Are**  
  
**ABOUT ENOVIS™**  
  
Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. For more information about Enovis, please visit www.enovis.com.  
  
**What You'll Do**  
  
At Enovis™ we pay attention to the details. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients, and take pride in the pursuit of scientific excellence — with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it.  
  
Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.  
  
As a key member of the Surgical Business Unit, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward through transforming patient care and creating better patient outcomes.  
  
**Job Title**  
  
Senior Global Product Manager, Enabling Technologies  
  
**Reports To**  
  
Leader of Global Product Management - Enabling Technologies  
  
**Location:**  
  
Austin, TX  
  
**Business Unit Description**  
  
U.S. Surgical - Enabling Technology  
  
**Job Title/High-Level Position Summary**  
  
We are seeking a Senior Global Product Manager to lead strategic product initiatives within our Enabling Technologies portfolio. This role is responsible for driving the development and commercialization of advanced surgical technologies that leverage software, digital innovation, data intelligence, and emerging technologies to improve orthopedic outcomes and procedural efficiency.  
  
The Senior Product Manager will play a critical role in defining product strategy, identifying future growth opportunities, and leading cross-functional teams through product development and launch. This individual will work closely with surgeons, engineers, clinical teams, and business leaders to shape the long-term direction of Enovis' enabling technology portfolio.  
  
This position requires strong strategic thinking, leadership, customer engagement, and the ability to navigate complex product development initiatives from concept through commercialization. Enovis is a leader in medical technology and has continued to grow our organization and product space.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  

* Lead upstream product strategy and innovation initiatives for Enovis' Enabling Technology portfolio.
* Define product vision, long-term roadmaps, and strategic priorities aligned with business objectives.
* Identify opportunities for market expansion, differentiation, and competitive advantage.
* Develop business cases and commercialization strategies for new technologies and platform initiatives.
* Partner closely with R&D and engineering leaders to guide development programs and ensure customer needs remain central to design decisions.
* Establish and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders and strategic customers.
* Conduct advanced market, customer, and competitive analyses to identify trends and future opportunities.
* Lead voice-of-customer activities and translate insights into product requirements and strategic recommendations.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales, clinical, regulatory, quality, and operations teams to ensure successful launches and product adoption.

**Who We’re Looking For**  
  
**Passionate About Technology**  
  

* An evangelist for software driven medical products who understands the benefits that technology can bring to patients

**Highly engaged and adaptable**  
  

* Self-motivated and driven with the ability to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

**Customer-oriented high achiever**  
  

* Unparalleled work ethic and customer-focused approach, keeping the customer top-of-mind in everything they do.

**Decision maker**  
  

* Able to analyze complex reports, situations, and information or data that require in-depth evaluation of various factors to make decisions and/or recommendations.

**Relationship builder**  
  

* Builds and maintains relationships internally and with key customer groups that drive business performance.

**Team player**  
  

* Puts team above all else and is willing to roll up their sleeves to get the job done.

**Minimum Basic Qualifications**  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 6-10 years in product management, product marketing or medical device sales, with direct experience in enabling technologies.
* 4+ years of experience in medical device marketing or equivalent experience in medical device sales, with a strong preference for upstream product development exposure.
* Strong fluency in digital tools; experience with data analytics, software development platforms, or engineering is a plus.
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills and a passion for solving clinical problems through technology.
* Excellent communication skills—able to translate technical concepts into clear, compelling messaging for diverse audiences.

This senior product management leader will set the vision and evolve the strategy, roadmap, and business plan for a complex offering spanning instrumentation, software, and assay content, with a focus on delivering a compelling, end-to-end solution to decentralized clinical customers.
